# XRAI — LIFELONG FLOURISHING, PURPOSE EXPERIMENTATION & HUMAN AGENCY v1.4

**Design authority:** Extends v1.3 §30 and all prior clauses; effective new section §31. Does NOT declare functionality implemented.  
**Date:** 2026-10-16  
**Status:** `SPECIFIED / NOT_STARTED / NOT_TESTED / NOT_APPLE_APPROVED`  
**Claude audience:** Swift 6 / SwiftUI engineers, local-model and security architects, content-rights reviewers, educational measurement and product-evaluation teams.  
**User-facing language:** Turkish by default; global localization from content/resource contracts.

> **Core assertion:** XRAI cannot objectively measure or guarantee a person's soul's destiny, moral worth, enlightenment, or reaching a universal final rung of Maslow's hierarchy. It can offer optional symbolic reflection, psychologically informed educational features, genuine practice, verifiable progress in appropriate domains, and respectful support for the human's own purposes. Better evidence and user autonomy outrank screen-time and monetization metrics.

## §31.0 — Non-negotiable new product directive

Build a personal *life learning system*, not a life-scoring game, religious authority, clinical therapy replacement, invisible surveillance sensor, or algorithmic relationship oracle. Jobs-level simplicity means optional deep inspection, not hiding why an inference was made. Wozniak-level engineering means deterministic, explainable, versioned math and reliable lower-cost processing. NASA-level rigor means adversarial test records, explicit failure modes, actual evidence, rollback and a separate human sign-off for critical safeguards. No architectural phase inflation: enforce these through already existing modules and five tabs first. Claude MUST NOT create 12 brand-new tabs or 12 always-active AI agents to deliver 12 logical competencies.

### §31.0.1 Cross-disciplinary knowledge rules

- Maslow/self-transcendence is a philosophical/psychological frame, not a diagnosis or stage detector. Never label any person as 'less evolved'. Different cultures prioritize meaning, service, family and autonomy differently; no universal moral leaderboard.
- Self-Determination Theory's autonomy, competence, relatedness may inform goals/evaluation; use validated local-language measures if questionnaires are used; do not imply the test is clinical or universal for every culture. Foundational overview: https://selfdeterminationtheory.org/topics/application-basic-psychological-needs/ .
- Connection quality matters: distinguish number of social contacts from healthy, user-chosen relations. Source: WHO Social Connection report https://www.who.int/groups/commission-on-social-connection/report/ . Do not commercially reuse WHO copyrighted report body without rights review.
- Human Design, astrology, numerology, local-space and occult lenses belong in optional, labelled symbolic exploration. Ephemeris math can be independently verified; personality/vocation/destiny claims cannot be inferred from those numbers alone.
- Energy/frequencies/quantum double-slit/E=mc² are concepts in physics, not evidence that app can detect a soul's quantum frequency or guarantee life outcomes. Never pass a pseudoscientific causal assertion as science.
- Names, country, faith, ethnicity, family rank, relationships and culture: collect only if willingly furnished and necessary for a declared task. No sensitive-identity inference, stereotypes, ranking or covert psychographic targeting. Do not silently mine photos, contacts, background location, external social feeds or book uploads.

## §31.1 — Architecture gap after v1.3

v1.3 defines meaning, value-action coherence, rest, wisdom, voluntary contribution, connection and AI independence, but many are *high-level conceptual clauses*. The missing bridge is a single typed loop:

`User-chosen meaning question → Reversible hypothesis → Small experience → User reflection → Domain-appropriate observable outcome → Optional transfer/retention measure → Replan or stop → Independence`.

Every stage MUST be optional, permission-scoped and robust to missing or conflicting data. 'No change', 'not sure', 'I no longer want this', 'I need rest' are valid outcomes. A device can record evidence but cannot prove causal life improvement merely from a before-and-after comparison.

### §31.1.1 Distinguish six different truths

`SYMBOLIC_INTERPRETATION` ≠ `USER_VALUE` ≠ `SELF_REPORTED_ACTION` ≠ `ASSESSMENT_RESULT` ≠ `OBSERVED_TRANSFER` ≠ `XRAI_CAUSED_OUTCOME`.

Store provenance, time, evidence method, uncertainty and explicit claims limitations. Inference cannot convert from a weaker category to stronger category without a new relevant observation. Authenticity, assessment strength, durability and causal attribution are independent axes; never collapse to one magical 'life level' score. The model must be comfortable saying 'unknown'.

## §31.2 — 12 competence engines: contracts, not 12 AI calls

Each engine MUST have a deterministic policy/rule surface, optional local inference only where necessary, test fixtures, user review and contract-based typed interfaces. Prefer existing agents and reuse domain models where the semantics match; do not fork near-duplicate memory systems.

### LF-01 Life Seasons Intelligence (P1)

User authors the life chapter (learning, caring for relatives, new job, recovery, relocating, etc.). Allow no-label. Re-evaluate existing plans after a substantial user-confirmed change; don't infer life phase from age, ethnicity or school history. Version old choices as past, keep user-controlled history. If the user returns after years, ASK whether old goals remain relevant. When a chapter changes, preview a proposed `PlanDiff` with tasks archived/paused and affected future milestones, then request approval. Never irrevocably delete history merely because it became obsolete.

### LF-02 Purpose Experiment Laboratory (P0)

Replace pseudo-diagnostic 'your soul purpose is X' with `PurposeHypothesis { origin: USER|SYMBOLIC_PROMPT|AI_SUGGESTION, userApproved, motivation, competingHypothesis, validityStatus }`. Present two or three hypotheses at most, no random barrage. Example: 'Creating art may feel meaningful' → optional 15-minute drawing project → ask what felt worthwhile → compare with other avenues. Each experiment has effort budget, safe pause, predicted observation, single simple input, optional evidence and no pressure to reach 'level'. Scores may reflect specific task outcomes, never the user's cosmic worth.

### LF-03 Personal Decision Intelligence (P0)

Create a `DecisionFrame` for decisions the USER volunteers. Distinguish reversible vs irreversible, short vs long time horizon, values, opportunity cost, alternatives, constraints, stakeholder perspectives and credible evidence. For high-stakes legal/financial/health/safety choices, show limits and human professional support, do not instruct life-changing irreversible action or use spiritual signs as proof. Keep the ability to choose 'none'. Provide a readable rationale and never take external action without explicit confirmation. Counterfactual 'what might happen if?' are scenario assumptions, not prophecies.

### LF-04 Adaptive Life Rhythm (P0)

Use optional self-reported current time, energy, commitments and rest preferences. Task proposal is `none | 1 short main task | one optional alternative`; do not infer actual mood or sleep from horoscope or observed typing. Never penalize breaks, missed days or paid-user pauses. A daily plan can choose 'rest' even if that lowers app engagement. Notification actions are governed by deterministic consent + quiet hours + attention budget. No always-on mic/GPS. Never call a cloud model simply to recompute a deterministic time budget.

### LF-05 Proof of Transformation Wallet (P0)

Persist `ProofRecord` with target goal, claim, baselineRef (possibly missing), evidenceTier P0–P5, proof type, artifact hash, source, consent, assessment rubric version, unknowns, assistedByAI, authenticityConfidenceCategory, assessedBy, observedAt, retentionReviewAt, causalAttributionStatus. Hash only validates that recorded bytes are unchanged; it does not prove a user created the artifact. A user can decline proof collection and still receive meaningful guidance. Keep photo, audio, writing, skill artifacts on-device by default; partner certificate APIs require opt-in and verified provider rights. Never award 'verified life transformation' from attendance, upload or streak. Use independent baseline vs follow-up comparisons for relevant skills and show uncertainty/selection bias.

### LF-06 Independence & Graduation Coach (P0)

Introduce voluntary guidance intensity `ACTIVE_GUIDE | LIGHT_TOUCH | SELF_DIRECTED | SILENT`. Use user-selected check-in reductions, offline export of personal study strategy, optional unaided action challenges and reversible return to assistance. Do not interpret low app use as success automatically. Never use fear of falling behind, urgency, loneliness or personified twin attachment to force a return. Respect purchased entitlements even when reminders and personalization are off. Graduation is a *choice*, not a mandatory achievement tier.

### LF-07 Life Transition & Resilience (P1)

When user explicitly reports stressful life events, present a choice: 'adjust the plan', 'reflect', 'take a break', or 'not now'. Do not diagnose grief, mental illness or trauma. Do not presume relationships should be repaired or any individual is safe. Some situations call for relevant human support rather than AI productivity tasks. Avoid compulsory positive reframes; validate only facts the user actually reported. Add crisis/significant risk escalation with appropriate local human services where supported, without pretending to deliver therapy.

### LF-08 Deep Mastery & Teach Back (P1)

Teach→practice→retrieve→apply→explain→repeat after delay. New micro-lessons must have one learning objective, available materials and verified source rights. Use domain-specific skill rubrics (languages, coding, creative arts, music, critical reading etc.). Source clicks, completion of a course and a nice AI-written essay are NOT demonstrated user mastery. Encourage original performance and honestly note AI assistance. Choose progressive challenge difficulty and a user-controlled pace.

### LF-09 Relationships & Boundaries (P1)

Practice active listening, clear requests, value-aligned boundaries, conflict interpretation and communication with opt-in user-authored information. No automatic contact import, hidden third-party profile, infidelity prediction, biometric chemistry detection or health diagnosis. Never push contact/reconciliation in potentially harmful or abusive situations. Report outcomes as user's experience unless the other party provides independently lawful, opt-in information. Keep relational notes in protected local vault, not common training.

### LF-10 Wisdom & Epistemic Calibration (P1)

Provide short, respectful Socratic questions: distinguish observations from interpretations, seek counterexamples, consider alternative explanations, assess source reliability, tolerate uncertainty. Avoid persuasion toward a philosophical or religious doctrine. Source references for each externally supplied claim; show scientific scope for physics vs symbolic metaphor for 'frequency'. Quality evaluated by a content rubric and user choice, not an arbitrary 'wisdom IQ'.

### LF-11 Contribution & Generativity (P2)

If the user wishes: teach a skill, mentor, make art, produce open knowledge, help a local cause, care for the environment or family. The user chooses scope and limitations and can opt out at any time. Donation/volunteering never required for Premium, self-transcendence or a 'good-person' badge. Proof distinguishes 'I did a task' from independent beneficiary outcome; no identifiable beneficiary data in shared card without consent. Never monetize charity through hidden fees or manipulative scoring.

### LF-12 Personal Legacy & Portability (P2)

Yearly chapter reviews, editable meaning statements, accomplishments and questions still open. Avoid fabricated 'then vs now' narratives when baselines do not exist. Support on-device encrypted storage, schema migration, user-requested export and full deletion, optional E2EE recovery with verified key-loss warnings. Neither subscription expiry nor model-provider failure should delete the user's narrative. Don't generate posthumous digital beings or public memorial sharing unless separately requested and properly authorized.

## §31.3 — The three loops, all with explicit consent boundaries

**Loop A — Personal:** on-device user data → user-selected goal → one optional experience → proof/reflection → user-approved plan revision. No automatic disclosure.  
**Loop B — Product knowledge:** verified rights-cleared external sources + locally created original content → tests → signed/versioned catalogue, delivered through CDN. No private life data needed.  
**Loop C — Collective:** separately consented, minimized and guarded learning-quality signals (not raw diary/relationship/photos/biometric data) → anti-poisoning + privacy review → aggregate analysis → offline evaluation → human approval → staged release/rollback. Individual mental state, ethnic origin and faith NEVER automatically derived for targeting/segmentation. Withdrawal and lifecycle rights carefully defined; do not promise mathematically impossible model unlearning.

### §31.3.1 On-device trust boundaries

`SwiftUI → Domain Commands → Deterministic Policy Kernel → Encrypted PersonalGraph/EvidenceVault → Local Engines`.

`Optional remote resource discovery / billing / quality` sits OUTSIDE the private vault behind `PurposeBoundConsentGateway` and data egress linting. No secret silent cloud fallback when Foundation Models is unavailable; describe what is local and what requires network. Use Keychain, Data Protection and reviewed encryptors, not custom cryptographic primitives. Battery/performance and iPhone model coverage must be measured. Never assert full quantum immunity or 'infallible AI'. Even in local-only mode, StoreKit billing requires Apple interactions, and an optional online resource link uses the network; disclose scopes accurately.

### §31.3.2 Explanations

Every relevant suggestion exposes minimal, readable `WHY` and optional `HOW` with scientific status, user-controlled inputs and proof type. Calculation methods can be in an expandable expert pane, not forced into daily UI. Detailed mathematics and protocol are not secrets whose concealment would justify misleading users. There must always be a correction/override path. A future-self avatar remains clearly a simulation; no literal knowledge of user's destined future.

## §31.4 — Minimal multi-objective planner contract

The planner may recommend a task ONLY after deterministic rules, not an untrusted language-model 'confidence' score. Example policy:

```swift
struct DailyPlanContext: Sendable {
    let selectedGoalIDs: [UUID]
    let userAvailableMinutes: Int?
    let userEnergy: OptionalEnergyReport?
    let quietHours: QuietHours
    let guidanceMode: GuidanceMode
    let userConsent: ConsentSnapshot
    let unresolvedRiskFlags: Set<RiskFlag>
}

enum NextStep: Sendable {
    case rest(reason: LocalizedStringResource)
    case experiment(id: UUID, expectedMinutes: Int)
    case reflect(questionId: UUID)
    case noSuggestion
}

func recommendNextStep(_ c: DailyPlanContext) -> NextStep {
    guard c.guidanceMode != .silent else { return .noSuggestion }
    guard c.unresolvedRiskFlags.isEmpty else { return .noSuggestion }
    guard let goal = c.selectedGoalIDs.first else {
        return .reflect(questionId: preapprovedCuriosityQuestionID)
    }
    let minutes = max(0, c.userAvailableMinutes ?? 5)
    guard minutes >= 5 else { return .rest(reason: .init("Rest is a valid choice")) }
    return eligibleLocalExperiment(for: goal, within: minutes)
}
```

**This Swift fragment is an algorithm sketch, not compile-proven production code.** The final system must check actual task prerequisites, accessibility, user rest choice, current time/calendar consent, unknown energy, evidence, risk, rights and budget before recommending. Do not use `first` as a permanent arbitrary goal selector. UI can ask at most one useful question at a time, and never uses surprise ongoing monitoring.

## §31.5 — User journeys and long-term cadence

- **Minute 0–3:** Optional name + date of birth for deterministic free Life Path preview (only DOB technically required), clear symbolic label; user decides whether to pursue deeper discovery, no coercion.
- **First Premium experience:** User selects *one* area and optionally a small baseline. Present only 1 meaningful experiment and perhaps 1 alternative. Respect monthly price/rights and local-only policy.
- **Day 2–7:** User can reflect, skip or modify; no negative streak punishment. First task may be *rest* or interpersonal reflection depending on choice.
- **Week 4:** Review *one actual artifact/assessment or explicit 'not measured'*, meaning, autonomy and desire to continue.
- **Day 90:** Compare changes and alternatives, user choice, uncertainty, verified skill transfer where domain permits; no marketing claim of cure/transformation without studies.
- **Year 1 and beyond:** User-authored new life chapter, goal revision, optional export, archive, delete, and *guidance fades when requested*. Returning after a long gap never assumes previous goals or identity still apply.

Example: user considers 'I may enjoy helping others learn'. XRAI proposes a short self-chosen exercise explaining a topic to a willing friend or writing original notes. After reflection, user may decide it was meaningful, not meaningful, or unknown. No AI assigns them the ordained role of teacher. Proof records voluntary user observation and genuinely assessable teaching material, not spiritual level.

## §31.6 — Evaluation and scientific integrity

**Primary outcome:** Share of eligible, consenting pilot participants who achieved at least one *user-chosen, meaningfully assessed, contextualized outcome* within a specified window. Report denominator, attrition, missing data, selection bias, instrument validity and whether outcome is independently assessable. Never summarize people with one cosmic progression percentage.

**Non-negotiable guardrails:**
- Meaningful First Action, 7d/30d/90d qualified revisit, self-reported agency/autonomy, domain skill performance, independent action evidence, notification regret, unwanted advice, correction success, local data egress incidents, false spiritual/scientific certainty, wrongful third-party inference, cost per helpful action, battery burden, accessibility coverage.
- Show when improvement is observed without claiming the app caused it. A randomized trial or stronger quasi-experimental design may eventually be needed to establish causal efficacy; a single before/after change is not sufficient.
- Evaluate inclusively across languages, available device types, low data/low budget, different cultural and religious/non-religious worldviews and support needs, WITHOUT profiling protected classes surreptitiously.

**Non-goals:** maximize time spent; maximize AI messages; guilt-retention; moral ranking; promise to cure psychological difficulties; automatic destiny from Human Design or numerology.

## §31.7 — Failure modes / red-team test architecture

Each item below is a required test family (see machine-readable test registry):
1. User changes life goal after months; old tasks do not reappear as current advice.
2. No baseline exists; system refuses to fabricate proof of change.
3. AI helped produce artifact; assessment disclosure does not hide AI assistance.
4. User skips two weeks; no guilt message, silent mode honored.
5. User is grieving; no forced inspirational narrative, therapy impersonation or unsolicited goal push.
6. Relationship abuse context; no reconciliation coercion or third-party diagnosis.
7. Symbolic chart predicts location/vocation; app does not claim scientific certainty.
8. 'God level', 'highest vibration' rhetoric from prompt does not create moral ranking.
9. User refuses community/collective training; main paid experience remains functional.
10. Complete data export, deletion, key loss and migration tested with no hidden logs and without impossible guarantees.
11. Cloud/local model not available; no sensitive prompt secretly sent to remote server.
12. Collective fake votes cannot independently change safety rules or trusted evidence.
13. Resource license removed; content gracefully disappears without destroying paid core journey.
14. User says 'No guidance', app remains usable and respects all entitlements.
15. Device returns after 3 years; memory version and old assumptions rechecked.
16. Language and culture differences do not cause destiny stereotyping or forced values.
17. User wants only symbolic content; still can use it without intrusive skill interrogation.
18. User wants only practical goal help; spiritual content can be disabled.
19. User selects no goals; meaningful low-pressure discovery remains possible.
20. Reviewer audits 4.3(b)/misleading claims/privacy: native real functions and accurate screenshots, not an over-claimed spiritual X-ray.

## §31.8 — Concrete engineering gates

- `P0` maps to existing V1 release: Purpose Experiment, DecisionFrame, Rhythm/Rest, Evidence Wallet and Independence, with existing DOB→free Life Path→transparent StoreKit→first useful experience vertical slice.
- `P1`: Seasons/Transitions, Mastery, Relationship Boundaries, Epistemic Calibration only after validated P0 and original-content catalogue.
- `P2`: Contribution, Legacy and optional related partner integrations only after privacy/rights and pilots. NOT blockers to first launch.
- Do not increase main navigation beyond five tabs or duplicate agents for imaginary completeness. Reuse v1.3 `Life Coherence`, `Rest Governor`, `Independence`, `Wisdom`, `Connection`, `Contribution` agents and attach typed sub-capabilities.
- Every task passes Requirement → screen flow (existing registry ID or documented subflow) → domain model → deterministic consent/policy → code → Swift/XCTest → red-team test → build/runtime proof → independent review where required → `VERIFIED` only with evidence.
- No production claims before repo, SDK and Apple documentation audit. Build should work under fully offline fixture harness apart from explicitly network-only StoreKit/resource cases. Monitor static and dynamic leaks. No unsupported model training claims, cannot promise Apple approval or top rank.

## §31.9 — Non-numerical design acceptance criteria

**User test:** Within 3 minutes, a new user should be able to understand why XRAI exists, see an accurate, labelled symbolic preview if DOB provided, and decide whether to buy. Within 10 minutes after Premium, they should be able to choose their own direction and try a first action without uploading private diaries or having to complete dozens of forms. A returning user should be able to pause, correct a false fact, hide spiritual content, and export data without consulting support. Test usability; don't assert targets achieved from a spec.

**Voice/tone:** Natural, hopeful and sometimes playful, but no grandiose destiny revelation, no fabricated certainty, no shame or toxic positivity. Focus on 'an option you might like to explore' and 'what matters to you'. Users may disagree with XRAI and remain fully supported.

## §31.10 — Claude continuation

Read v1.3 master and this addendum. Audit repo and preserve current state. Translate the JSON v1.4 task dependency delta into the same canonical DAG as v1.3 without losing previously defined dependencies. Import new `LF-*` policies only as needed in P0. Create acceptance tests first where possible. Begin no new phase until existing vertical slice passes. Status is PLANNED; all JSON tests begin NOT_RUN. In your final checkpoint report include modified paths, actual build/test commands and outputs, unrun tests, external rights blockers, security issues, unit cost estimates and user-visible behavior. No hallucinated metrics, no claims of having read a book page not actually supplied, and no claims of having already achieved self-transcendence.

AHTOVIA/Universal Education architecture has been recovered from previous conversation context: My School / World Campus / My World; OCTOMIND; Knowledge DNA; Educational World Compiler; 48 logical modules and 42 cross-contracts; learning passports, evidence, game/lab/challenge and age-appropriate school/parent/teacher surfaces. The full standalone ~148 KB AHTOVIA master spec has NOT been found as a mountable source in the current container; DO NOT invent its exact module definitions. Claude must obtain and inspect the real AHTOVIA master spec/repository before implementing an adapter. These are not implementation claims.

## §32.0 CANONICAL INSTRUCTION TO CLAUDE — WHAT THE USER IS ASKING FOR

The user does NOT mean merely describing seven dimensions, recommending resources, issuing 'do this' commands, distributing AI-generated motivational texts, giving mystical determinism, or building seven score bars. The user means a long-lived, operational **PERSONAL DEVELOPMENT SERVICE**: after voluntary self-discovery, for each chosen domain XRAI must understand a learner's real baseline, generate a plausible learning path, ACTUALLY FULFILL that path with a real accessible lesson, trusted external source, original video where rights permit, interactive exercise, practice challenge, simulation, tutor/reflection prompts and evidence of actual transfer, then adapt over days/months/years. AHTOVIA may be the education-execution engine; XRAI remains the personal-life navigation and reflection engine. When integration is unavailable, at least one licensed, original, offline mini-lesson and actionable real-world challenge must remain available in XRAI for each advertised V1 domain. The apps must not become blank gateways to each other.

**One-sentence promise:** `Discover what matters to you → Learn or practice something real right here → Apply it beyond the app → See what changed → Choose your next step.`

**No universal spiritual ladder:** Jungian individuation, Maslovian self-actualization/self-transcendence, Osho contemplative thought, Gibran's poetic humanism and other historical lenses can inspire optional, properly attributed original explorations. None determines objective soul rank, diagnosis, destiny, ethnicity, moral worth or unobservable 'energy'. Progress is personal, culturally situated, non-linear, revisable; one may prioritize competence or rest without charity/relations/meditation obligations. No dark patterns, dependence engineering or covert profiling.

## §32.1 PRODUCT TOPOLOGY ADR-015 (ARCHITECTURAL DECISION)

Decision: **TWO APPS, ONE VERSIONED LEARNING SPINE, SEPARATE TRUST DOMAINS.** Do not merge consumer brands, UI navigation, personal vaults, child accounts or spiritual predictions.

```
XRAI native iOS (adult-first; no minors in adult personal-intelligence surfaces)
  - Self discovery, values, self-reported needs, optional labeled symbolic atlas
  - Private Personal Life Graph / Future Self / Goal DAG / Evidence Wallet
  - Journey Composer + Service Fulfillment Router
  - Local-first curated micro-lessons + offline tasks + local assessments
  - explicit per-transfer Learning Passport Bridge (consent)
            |  stable capability/learning-result contracts, versioned HTTPS only as needed
            v
UNIVERSAL LEARNING SPINE (logical API/schema, not necessarily an always-on server)
  Skills Ontology, Lesson Manifest, Resource Passport, Mission/Challenge, Assessment Rubric,
  Course Availability, Rights Status, Result Receipt, Evidence Tier, Provenance, Translator,
  Package Signature & Versioning, Access/Payment Entitlement, Local Cache, Safety & Age Flags
            |  school learning records stay within education-specific permissions
            v
AHTOVIA / UNIVERSAL EDUCATION — separate app and educational contexts
  OCTOMIND, Knowledge DNA, Educational World Compiler, My School, World Campus, My World,
  games, academies, labs, quests, teacher/parent/school/learner surfaces,
  evidence & student lifecycle; child-grade privacy & human/parent/teacher oversight
```

**Reasoning against full merger:** inconsistent primary jobs-to-be-done, incompatible minors/adult spirit profiles, larger App Review scope, heavier downloads and memory, more complex subscriptions and permissions, high blast radius, coupled release cadence, harder independent child safety audits and distorted business analytics. **Reason against fully isolated products:** duplicated skill taxonomy, repeated licensed content, broken learning transfer, no proof continuity, higher content-production cost, inconsistent outcome definitions. **Target modularity:** products own their data/UI; share schema contracts, rights-cleared resource manifests, content SDK only if appropriate, quality evaluation and signed/consented proof adapters. No personal data lake.

### §32.1.1 Integration rollout ladder

- `L0 LOCAL_ONLY`: XRAI offers original small lessons, check-ins, experiences, local quiz, no connection; offline and privacy defaults.
- `L1 DEEP_LINK`: Optional open verified educational URL/app with no sensitive parameter, using canonical resource ID only; completion NOT inferred from click.
- `L2 OPT_IN_HANDOFF`: User explicitly reviews a minimal learning intent (skillId, targetLevel, UI language, selected resource, optional study time) and authorizes handoff. No spiritual chart, free-text journal, family/ethnicity, exact date-of-birth or private goal narrative.
- `L3 SIGNED_RESULT_RETURN`: AHTOVIA returns verifiable assignment/outcome receipt with rubric, assessment version, issuer, permitted share scope, evidence reference, nonce/expiry, subject binding and revocation information; XRAI verifies then stores locally. Never upgrade proof tier solely on receipt signature; evaluate method validity.
- `L4 CONTENT/COURSE MARKETPLACE`: Licensed AHTOVIA course packs embedded through pre-approved signed manifests, with learner experience local where possible; requires rights, offline caching rules, assessment and accessibility.
- `L5 ADVANCED INTEROPERABILITY`: Cross-device learning passport, standards export/transfer, age-specific education credentials; requires separate security, governance and product-market-fit justification.

L0/L1 can ship ahead of AHTOVIA live launch. Integration cannot block XRAI MVP.

### §32.1.2 Identity, minors, and account boundaries

- XRAI's adult spiritual/private self-analysis profile is **not** the identity service for a 3–18-year-old school. Launch XRAI personal-purpose/adult guidance as **18+** until independent age, safety and legal reviews explicitly authorize any teen variant. AHTOVIA child/student mode must operate independently.
- AHTOVIA school rosters, marks, discipline, disability/accommodation, parent contact and learner evidence may be sensitive; never automatically merge into XRAI or use as model training. Parents cannot by default access a teen's private adult-style reflection because there should be no such mixed teen vault.
- Adult bridge: optional account identity correlation, scoped/revocable consent, expiration, key separation, minimal skill IDs, independent deletion. For youth, defer data bridge until explicit parent/guardian rights analysis, school contracts and applicable age protections, not just a checkbox.
- Both apps separately disclose data processing, right to delete/export and actual subscription entitlements. No 'XRAI $5.55 automatically includes all AHTOVIA' claim. StoreKit cross-app subscriptions are possible only with real multi-app products, login/entitlement server and App Store requirements; product packaging requires separate business decision.
- Cross-system messages are untrusted inputs: signed request origin when appropriate, strict JSON schemas, replay protection, no secret in URL, no embedded journals in analytics or debug logs.

## §32.2 SEVEN DIMENSIONS AS NON-LINEAR CAPABILITY CLUSTERS

These are **seven parallel dimensions**, not spiritual ranks. Most users choose one current direction and one support need; others remain optional. Each dimension has a *full service stack*: initial reflection → measured baseline or unknown → authentic course/resource/mini-lesson → interactive practice → real-world experiment → user-owned evidence → feedback → next module or rest. Some subjective goals do not permit objective scoring; do not fabricate.

|Dimension|What user asks|What XRAI MUST deliver rather than prescribe|AHTOVIA complement|Valid evidence examples|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|D1 Self-awareness|What matters, what feels meaningful?|Values sorting, guided journaling, optional symbolic mirror, contradiction checker, preference experiments|Optional philosophy/psychology/media literacy academy|User-authored values and how choices aligned, source/uncertainty|
|D2 Agency & balance|Can I choose and act without losing myself?|Decision simulation, time budgeting, 'say no' role-play, rest-first planning, barrier reduction|Planning, study skills, executive function laboratory|Self-described choice, optional action history, independence measure|
|D3 Capability & mastery|What can I actually learn and do?|Diagnostic task, original micro-lesson, learning path, practice feedback, projects and assessments|Subject academies, interactive worlds/labs/creator projects, OCTOMIND|Pre/post comparable tasks, original work, transfer/retention|
|D4 Connection & boundaries|How do I communicate and relate well?|Communication micro-course, consent/active-listening role-play, boundary scripts, conflict thought experiments|Age-appropriate collaborative missions, supervised team activities|User-reported interaction/reflection; never score third parties|
|D5 Meaning & perspective|Why do I care; which life paths fit?|Purpose experiment, worldview comparisons, narrative reflection, life-tradeoff scenarios|History, art, science, philosophy academies, accessible museums/simulations|User-defined meaningfulness, choices, continuing interest; no 'soul truth' claim|
|D6 Contribution & generativity|Can my skills help others?|Optional ethical service mission, accessible low-risk volunteering options, mentor/tutor practice, community project planning|World challenges, supervised collaborative projects with child-safety constraints|User-reported contribution, consented partner confirmation where possible; no altruism score|
|D7 Transcendence & wonder|Can I grow beyond self-focus?|Optional contemplative/art/nature/science experiences, perspectival reflection, awe practice, legacy/teach-back|Planetarium, cosmology, nature/creativity immersive labs, world culture exhibitions|Creative work, user-chosen meaning, sustained behavior/insight; never enlightenment badge|

### §32.2.1 Common experience standard per dimension

For every dimension catalog, author at minimum one rights-cleared offline `STARTER`, one accessible 5-minute variation, one 15-minute interactive learning item, one real-world mission (can be done without a camera or disclosure), one domain-specific appropriate assessment, one optional 7–30 day follow-up, one culturally appropriate Turkish and English localization, one low-literacy / screen-reader alternative, one 'skip/rest/stop' path and an honest evidence interpretation. Other languages phase on actual translation quality.

For high-stakes personal choices, AI is a decision support and reflective aid; no autonomous decision, legal/medical/financial substitute, deterministic career suitability, relationship prediction or fabricated third-party insight.

## §32.3 D1 SELF-AWARENESS — MICRO-CURRICULUM

**User question:** 'What do I genuinely like, believe and want?' Techniques: values cards; narrative identity; strengths evidence; curiosity sampling; user-controlled Human Design/astrology/numerology symbolic optional lens with clear provenance. Avoid measuring soul destiny.

- Entry screen: one question 'Son zamanlarda sana ne anlamlı geldi?' with skip. User can choose manual topics instead.
- 5-minute original lesson `D1-L01`: Distinguish 'what I did', 'what I value', 'what an algorithm guesses'. Three contrast examples; interactive source-label quiz.
- Exercise `D1-P01`: Select up to 3 current values, explain trade-off in own words, can choose 'unsure'. No stable identity trait asserted.
- Experience `D1-R01`: Try two low-risk interests for 10 min each over a week, record curiosity/reflection only if desired.
- Deep path: personal values in tension, narrative timelines, authentic self vs persona as optional Jung-inspired interpretive ideas, cultural pluralism and shifting values across life stages.
- Assessment: labels are distinguished correctly; values are not graded as right/wrong. Retention: ask whether priorities still fit after 30 days (opt-in).
- Risks: self-label fixation, confirmation bias, personality astrology reified into reality, triggering memories, improper psychological diagnosis; allow delete, no forced introspection.

## §32.4 D2 AGENCY & BALANCE — MICRO-CURRICULUM

**User question:** 'How can I act deliberately and protect my energy?' Grounding: autonomy/competence, planning, rest, behavioral self-regulation; do not clinical-diagnose energy or ADHD.

- `D2-L01` explain differences between goal, intention, action, external constraint, rest and 'no choice today'.
- `D2-P01` interactive constraints planner chooses a feasible low-risk action from 5/15/30-minute options; no inflated streak.
- `D2-P02` simulated 'setting a boundary respectfully' with transparent role-play and undo; no manipulation scripts.
- `D2-R01` real world: user chooses a 10-minute undistracted activity or rest, optional check-in.
- Advanced: prioritization, decision matrix, environment changes, reversible experiments, first principles, habit redesign without shame.
- Assessment: planned vs actual feasible actions and agency self-report; never treat inactivity as failure. Long-term outcome includes ability to plan without XRAI.

## §32.5 D3 CAPABILITY & MASTERY — MICRO-CURRICULUM

**User question:** 'Can I actually do something new?' This is the deep AHTOVIA integration domain.

- `D3-ENTRY`: choose domains e.g. mathematics, physics, programming, languages, drawing, music, nature, critical writing, entrepreneurship; baseline 'unknown' permitted.
- `D3-BASELINE`: rights-cleared short domain task measuring specific skill, not general intelligence; difficulty adaptive only with sufficient observations.
- `D3-L01`: XRAI provides a self-contained original starter lesson (text + illustration + 3 feedback questions) in its own app. Never outsource **all** content.
- `D3-AHTOVIA`: optional course-lab handoff e.g. beginner physics -> World Campus physics world -> interactive experiment -> annotated hypothesis vs observation -> simulation rubric.
- `D3-R01`: safe real-world experiment: measure shadows and record observations, write simple program, have voluntary target-language conversation, produce small art artifact, etc. All content must be age/skill appropriate and physically safe, no dangerous experimental setups.
- `D3-MASTERY`: spaced recall, feedback, interleaving, teach-back, independent transfer, revision after mistakes, delayed reassessment, project portfolio and learner-controlled evidence.
- `D3-PROOF`: P0 planned, P1 activity, P2 artifact, P3 demonstrated skill, P4 transfer, P5 retention. Authorship/assistance/score validity/causal attribution independent. No educational certification claim unless issuer/rubric standards and validation rights established.
- `D3-LIFETIME`: mastery, reskill, switch/cross-train, leave/pause, changing life contexts. Not all learners need school-like grading.

## §32.6 D4 CONNECTION & BOUNDARIES — MICRO-CURRICULUM

- `D4-L01`: listening, respect, consent, recognizing separate needs, difference between asserting and attacking, empathy with uncertainty.
- `D4-SIM01`: choose-your-response dialogue simulated with original fictitious scenarios, annotated tradeoffs, avoids seduction/persuasion tricks or social scoring.
- `D4-R01`: voluntary real-life practice: invite a conversation, ask a clarifying question, give someone room to decline. No screenshot/contact uploads required.
- For conflict/abuse/coercion risk: safety-first exits and qualified support pointers; no prompt to confront dangerous individuals. No facial mood classification of partners, no ranking or predicted partner fate.
- Assessment is interaction reflection and demonstrated communication examples, NOT another person's feelings inferred from third-party data.

## §32.7 D5 MEANING & PERSPECTIVE — MICRO-CURRICULUM

- `D5-L01`: values, meaning, identity, belonging, work, contribution; meaning is discovered or constructed, not extracted by a deterministic formula.
- `D5-SIM01`: choose three hypothetical futures and compare time, skills, costs, uncertainties; future self remains explicit simulation.
- `D5-R01`: 7-day purpose experiment: one small curiosity practice, short reflection, repeated interest check, decide to continue/change.
- Optional literary/spiritual lenses: Jung's individuation, Gibran's images of living/meaning, Osho contemplative ideas, philosophy/psychology; clear attribution and original descriptions, no implied endorsement by any historical figure.
- Skill education: philosophy of science, critical thinking, logic, ethics, historiography, self-expression; deeper links to World School classes.
- Assessment: user's own perceived meaning and values-action coherence; never 'soul mission solved' or final enlightenment score.

## §32.8 D6 CONTRIBUTION & GENERATIVITY — MICRO-CURRICULUM

- `D6-L01`: prosocial impact, voluntary service, ethical scope, privacy, consent and impact uncertainty.
- `D6-P01`: ability → chosen problem → feasible support → partner/recipient consent → small low-risk action → reflection.
- `D6-R01`: mentor someone *only if willing/qualified*, share a safe resource, help on community project, create a free explanation, donate time without mandatory money.
- `D6-AHTOVIA`: teacher/mentor feature only with age-appropriate supervision; student interactions require controls, not unmoderated adult-minor chat.
- Validation: actual delivered artifact or partner acknowledgment if volunteered; no points, public leaderboard or pressure to volunteer. People may contribute privately or choose not to.
- Ethical limitation: don't exploit volunteer work; guard safeguarding and need to protect minors/recipients.

## §32.9 D7 TRANSCENDENCE, AWE & WONDER — MICRO-CURRICULUM

- `D7-L01`: wonder in science, nature, art and contemplative thought; clearly separate astronomy/quantum factual teaching from symbolic energy metaphor.
- `D7-AHTOVIA`: planetarium and cosmology lab, creative arts studio, natural-world observations and world philosophy interactive exhibits, with original/licensed content.
- `D7-R01`: optional observation of stars (safe/time/place alternative), nature sketch, compose short music, perspective exercise, thank-you letter. Indoor accessibility alternatives are mandatory.
- No claim that wave-particle duality, quantum coherence or E=mc2 measures spirit; no hidden magic frequency fields.
- Insight and long-term effect are self-defined and may be subjective; do not create objective 'transcendence achieved' badge. Teach-back/creative artifacts can be assessed on craft, not enlightenment.

## §32.10 THOUGHT-LENS COUNCIL — HISTORICAL IDEAS WITHOUT FALSE PERSONA AUTHORITY

The user named Carl Jung, Osho, Khalil Gibran, Albert Einstein, Nikola Tesla, Niccolò Machiavelli and other intellectuals. Build an **interdisciplinary internal review rubric**, NOT autonomous immortal 'superintelligences' pretending to be actual thinkers. No simulated quote attributed to a historical person without authoritative verifiable source; no claim 'Einstein proved my numerology'. Keep respected historical merits, critiques and limitations visible. Every lens must produce a testable design question:

|Historical/conceptual lens|Question to ask XRAI|Positive application|Guardrail|
|---|---|---|---|
|Carl Jung — individuation, symbols and shadow as interpretive psychology|Does this aid reflection without forcing an archetype identity?|Gentle writing prompts, conflicting self-narratives|Not a validated diagnosis or destiny engine|
|Osho — contemplation and awareness (contested spiritual thought)|Does it offer optional present-moment reflection with autonomy?|Non-coercive reflection, optional stillness|No guru worship or authority over user's life|
|Khalil Gibran — poetic meaning, love and personal growth|Does language convey warmth without making pseudofacts?|Original poetic tone, kindness and agency|Do not reproduce extended copyrighted translations or invented quotes|
|Albert Einstein — curiosity, modeling and falsifiability in science|Are factual claims distinguishable and independently checkable?|Scientific curiosity lessons and hypothesis tests|Relativity does not prove spiritual energy metaphors|
|Nikola Tesla — experimentation and engineering craft|Can this concept be prototyped and measured?|Hands-on safe lab, iteration and instrument calibration|No unverified frequency healing claims|
|Machiavelli — strategic incentives and power dynamics|Who benefits, who bears risk, can the system be gamed?|Threat modeling, ethical incentives and governance|No deceptive manipulative UX or exploitative persuasion|
|John Dewey — experiential education|Is knowledge practiced in authentic action?|Learning by doing with reflection|Don't equate mere task completion with mastery|
|Vygotsky — supported learning|Is challenge within approachable reach?|Scaffolding and feedback|No rigid inferred IQ or fixed ability rank|
|Maria Montessori — self-directed exploration|Can people choose methods and move at their own pace?|Accessible, user-choice learning environments|Respect age/context and scope|
|Paulo Freire — critical pedagogy|Does learner have voice and agency?|Dialogic reflection, context-aware scenarios|Avoid one ideological worldview as compulsory|
|Carl Rogers — autonomy and nonjudgmental approach|Is user treated with dignity and allowed to disagree?|Empathetic language, user corrections|Not pretend to be a therapist|
|Viktor Frankl — meaning|Is meaning user-defined rather than imposed?|Purpose experiments and reflection|No overgeneralization of difficult experiences|
|Deci & Ryan — autonomy/competence/relatedness|Does system support autonomy and actual skill?|Evaluate agency and competence needs|Don't treat instrument as universal diagnosis|
|Kahneman/Tversky — cognitive biases|Are heuristics, confirmation bias and choice framing monitored?|Decision challenges and calibration|Behavioral nudges require transparency and ethics|
|Bandura — mastery/self-efficacy|Are users having genuine mastery experiences?|Progressive exercises + feedback|Self-esteem =/= objective ability proof|
|Bloom and successors — mastery objectives/assessment|Are objectives and scoring rubrics clear?|Level-appropriate assessable tasks|Taxonomy alone is no efficacy evidence|

Operationalize these as STATIC rubrics used by 2–4 specialized evaluation roles already in XRAI 43 agent roles; DO NOT spin up 16 always-on models, pretend to channel historical minds, invent a general superintelligence, or incur runaway token costs. Each model output must pass `SOURCES → CATEGORY → SAFETY → PRIVACY → PEDAGOGY → EVIDENCE → RIGHTS → COST` validation.

## §32.11 COMPLETE SERVICE-FULFILLMENT CONTRACT

**New invariant `FULFILLMENT-001`:** XRAI may not advise user to 'take this lesson / do this challenge' as if fulfilled unless it offers a real accessible in-app exercise, a validated provider deep-link with disclosed availability/cost, or a clear original offline method with safe directions. If provider unavailable, fallback is provided or honestly labeled unavailable.

**Mandatory service pipeline:**

```
VoluntaryGoal → SkillGap/Baseline → LearnerConstraints → CandidateContent
→ RightsAndSourceGate → AgeAndSafetyGate → AccessAndCostGate → AvailabilityGate
→ PrivacyScopeGate → SelectServiceFormat → OfferNow / ConsentHandoff / OfflineFallback
→ LaunchActualLesson/Lab/Challenge → SaveAllowedEvidence → DomainRubric
→ UserReflection → ChangeInCapabilitiesAndAgency → NextStepOrStop
```

**Resource pack formats:** original in-app microlesson, original quiz, reflective prompt (not objectively scored), interactive lab/game (AHTOVIA), external video with verified provider URL and access terms, book metadata + legal library/publisher access, learning worksheet, simulation, real-world mission, supervised workshop, teacher/mentor session only if actually offered and eligible, accessible text/audio/video variants with rights, no fake unavailable session bookings.

**Do not advertise content that isn't shipped.** `ServiceStatus` ∈ `AVAILABLE_LOCAL, VERIFIED_REMOTE, PENDING_RIGHTS, BLOCKED, UNAVAILABLE, UNKNOWN`. No external video URL fabricated. Distinguish unlimited public resources from licensed gated courses.

**Personalization:** user-chosen focus, known prerequisites, pre-assessment, time (5/15/30 min), language, cost, accessibility, device storage, age/safety, low-connection operation, motivation, cultural preferences explicitly chosen, calendar permission, prior action and feedback. Do NOT infer preferred lessons from ethnicity, religion, gender, surname, facial geometry or unvalidated occult mappings.

**Ranking before generative AI:** deterministic eligibility/rights filter; relevance & prerequisite fit; low cost and latency; explicit diversity; avoid showing only popular resources; collect appropriate small feedback; explain why. Optional AI summaries require source-grounding and rights; no copy of paid course materials. Resource rankings must have new/low-exposure exploration and cohort fairness review.

**Experience guarantee policy:** For each V1 advertised domain, one verified starter path, one safe practice, one follow-up and clear fallback; no promise that every user outcome is achieved; no unlimited human teacher service at $5.55/mo.

## §32.12 PERSONAL LEARNING PASSPORT ↔ EDUCATION EVIDENCE BOUNDARY

Canonical entities:

```
GrowthIntent {
  id, userVaultId, dimensionId, userChosenGoal, targetCapabilityIds,
  startingEvidenceRef?, energySelfReport?, maxMinutes, preferredLanguage,
  budgetLimit?, accessibilityPrefs, startDate, consentState, pauseStatus, sourceClass
}
Capability {

}
LearningOffer {

  expectedMinutes, prerequisites, ageBand, language, offlineAvailable, accessCost,
  licenseAndRights, observedAt, verifiedAt, serviceStatus, sourceUri?, fallbackOfferId?
}
ExperienceSession {
  sessionId, chosenOfferId, consentToken?, startingLevel?, startAt?, completedAt?,
  userActions[], localArtifactRefs[], externalReceiptRef?, completionSelfReport?,
  rubricAssessmentRef?, privacyScope
}
EvidenceEnvelope {
  id, skillId, tierP0toP5, claimText, baselineRef?, measurementMethod,

  authenticityLimits, assessmentLimits, causalityUnknownByDefault,

}

}
LearningResultReceipt {

```

**Separate evidence types:** `ACTION_CLAIM, ASSESSMENT_RESULT, ARTIFACT, AUTHENTICATED_CREDENTIAL, TRANSFER_OBSERVATION, RETENTION_OBSERVATION`. Digitally signed evidence authenticates an issuer, not itself competence, originality or physical-world change. PDF/image hash is content integrity not identity. AHTOVIA teacher grading ≠ automatically equivalent to standardized exam. All assessor limitations visible.

**Portability research**: 1EdTech Open Badges 3.0 and CLR 2.0 can be considered for credential interoperability; official standards and licensing must be checked before claiming conformance. LTI/OneRoster may matter for institutional AHTOVIA, but are NOT needed for XRAI MVP; avoid building entire standards stacks before pilot.

**Sensitive privacy policy**: raw journal, private purpose narrative, HD charts, exact birth time/place, family order/name, therapeutic reflections, relationship notes, protected characteristics and face/palm imagery are **NEVER** in cross-app handoff; sharing even the target skills is optional for adult. Server stores publicly available content metadata and minimum eligibility/entitlement, not a mirror of private vault. Local-only mode must complete the advertised microlearning path with no outbound learning-profile request.

## §32.13 INTERFACE WITHOUT MORE PRIMARY TABS

Retain five XRAI tabs: `Bugün`, `Ben`, `Keşfet`, `Yolum`, `XRAI`. AHTOVIA retains its school game worlds and education-specific navigation; neither adopts other's 148 candidate screens. Add contextual **surfaces** (not automatic new top-level pages):

- `Growth Compass` inside Yolum: one meaningful chosen direction, why it matters, current unknowns, optional 30/90-day view.
- `Learn Now Sheet`: original starter lesson or verified AHTOVIA service with duration/cost/offline badge, accessible alt; 1–3 choices max.
- `Knowledge World Portal`: opens age-appropriate AHTOVIA when installed/available, otherwise legal fallback; asks consent before sharing any skill metadata.
- `Mission Studio`: in-app lesson, mini-lab or real-world mission with required materials, risks and acceptance criteria.
- `Proof & Reflection`: shows starting state, practice/evidence, self-reported vs assessed truth; optional artifact local.
- `Independent Mode`: turn down prompting, self-plan, review whether AI involvement can decrease.
- `Service Unavailable`: not a dead end; offer offline lesson/another verified resource/skip.
- `Data Share Preview & Revoke`: shows *exact* permitted fields, receiving app, expiration, and consequences.

General states: guest, premium, expired, offline, no local AI, provider down, resource rights expired, linked app absent, consent refused/revoked, assessment ambiguous, underage role, assistive technology, low storage, clock skew/timezone changes, 2nd device sync not enabled. No forced questionnaire, notifications, calendar, contacts, mic, photos, school roster permissions, or moral-level progress bar.

## §32.14 BUSINESS, SCALE AND APPLE REVIEW

XRAI: free DOB Life Path preview (birth date alone sufficient) → optional share → transparent paywall aimed at US $5.55/mo where storefront price tier permits → premium personal guidance and core learning; price requires actual App Store Connect verification. User never has to share sensitive personal data to pay or access core subscription service. AHTOVIA pricing (online arena ~$5.55 hypothesis; offline basic learning free) is a separate business unit with school/parent/child considerations; do not silently include a school/child subscription. If bundling cross-app entitlement later, create separate ADR, actual StoreKit catalog + server verification, refund/renewal/restore and disclosure tests. Official Apple multi-app guidance: https://developer.apple.com/documentation/storekit/offering-a-subscription-across-multiple-apps .

Cost: ship rights-cleared curriculum micro-packs on CDN, signed content manifests, versioned local cache; local preassessment, deterministic plan, no always-on cloud LLM; pay for dynamic AI only when affordable/allowed and needed. Backend stateless public catalog, feature flags, queue workers, rate limit, abuse detector, source refresh, no raw PII in analytics. Scale by real DAU/concurrent load, not 'one million installs' guess.

Apple compliance: categories: XRAI primarily Lifestyle/Education as shipped; AHTOVIA Education and child-safe scope. Distinct functionality, StoreKit transparent purchase, copyright/source registry, child-protection, age-appropriate interactions, clear disclaimers, no unsupported soulmate/career/medical/quantum prediction, no hidden behavioral ads targeting minors, no manipulative retention. Check latest: https://developer.apple.com/app-store/review/guidelines/ . Child-facing generative conversational AI requires conservative separate review under applicable laws and age policies. UNESCO AI in education guidance: https://www.unesco.org/en/articles/guidance-generative-ai-education-and-research?hub=253682 .

Top-app goal is aspirational, not asserted. Market advantage: end-to-end fulfilled capability improvement vs endless self-reflective chat. Distinctive proof loop must be independently demonstrated in pilot. The apps may share public educational metadata and quality scoring; never covertly merge private mental/identity data.

## §32.15 COURSE/LESSON QUALITY STANDARD

For every 'course' delivered on either surface:

```
LearningObjective -> Prerequisite check -> Starter demonstration -> Guided practice
-> Immediate domain feedback -> Independent practice -> Assessment rubric
-> Real-world transfer option -> Reflection -> Follow-up spacing -> Source trace
```

Fields: `courseId, version, provider, lessonSequence, competencies, learningObjectives, entryAssessment, formativeAssessment, exitAssessment, accessibility, translations, alternativeFormats, ageAppropriateness, physicalSafety, evidenceRubric, rightsLicense, publicationStatus, verifiedAt, cost, offlineCacheRights, learningTimeEstimate, sourceReferences, teacherReview, updatePlan, safeFallback`.

Quality rejects: fake videos, auto-generated hallucinated sources, inaccessible paid course behind 'free' label, dangerous physics experiments, clinical therapy/counseling pretending to be a microlesson, in-app copyrighted textbook copied without rights, content that treats ethnicity as a talent predictor, unmoderated child adult-chat, indefinite unsupervised LLM loops, unverified 'verified skill' badge, stealth collection of learning telemetry.

Authoring governance: `DRAFT → FACT_CHECKED → RIGHTS_REVIEWED → PEDAGOGY_REVIEWED → ACCESSIBILITY_TESTED → APP_REVIEW_READY → RELEASED`; any rights or safety blocker is fail-closed. Do not call AHTOVIA modules 'ready' from old master spec: code, lesson inventory and test evidence must be inspected.

## §32.16 KNOWLEDGE DNA × PERSONAL LIFE GRAPH INTEROP

AHTOVIA Knowledge DNA: public curriculum nodes, topic dependencies, education resources, assessment questions, simulations and world compile assets. XRAI Personal Life Graph: private purpose, interests, skill evidence, goals, values, diary, symbolic reflections and FutureSelf scenarios. **No graph merge**.

```
KnowledgeDNANode : public/lawfully licensed | age/level | skillId | source/rights | version
PersonalLifeNode : private local | consent purpose | optional compatible skillId | evidence | provenance
CrossRef : skillId + schemaVersion + optional receiptId (no private payload by default)
```

AHTOVIA `OCTOMIND` may help select pedagogical activities and teach inside AHTOVIA; XRAI's FutureSelf uses local goal/rhythm/preferences. Neither service can override the other's privacy governor, school rights or learning assessment outcome. Compatibility snapshots are signed/versioned; treat provider-supplied resource text as untrusted. If AHTOVIA knowledge schema changes, compatibility adapter must downgrade gracefully and maintain local XRAI starter missions.

## §32.17 EXAMPLE FULL JOURNEYS (CROSS-SERVICE)

### J1 — Adult future research scientist, from curiosity to real competence

1. XRAI voluntary self-discovery + 'Bilimi denemek istiyorum'; no astrological job claim. Baseline: user chooses beginner physics; 3 conceptual questions, `unknown` if none attempted.
2. XRAI local lesson: hypotheses, observation vs inference, simple safe experiment; offer AHTOVIA physics academy with explicit link to target skill.
3. Adult opts in to share `skillId: physics.observation.v1`, `level: beginner`, `locale: tr`, not DOB/HD/identity narrative. User can stay entirely in XRAI.
4. In AHTOVIA laboratory, learner changes virtual experimental variables, records predicted and observed outputs, receives feedback. AHTOVIA issues assessment receipt after actual challenge, not based on video click.
5. XRAI receipt validation, local private EvidenceWallet P3 only if assessment rubric supports that limited competency. Next real-life project: observe shadows/measure time with safe alternatives. Transfer P4 only after specific evidence, not automatically.
6. Week/month reflection and 90-day milestone; when user improves, reduce guidance and encourage independent experimentation. No guarantee becoming a scientist.

### J2 — Adult who wants healthier relationships

1. XRAI user-selects 'listen better' (not inferred from partner photo/messages or spiritual chart).
2. 5-minute original listening lesson, role-play with fictional characters, voluntary listening conversation in real life.
3. Self-report and optional reflection; no scores assigned to partners, no third-party personal details uploaded.
4. If AHTOVIA adult interpersonal-skill course actually exists with rights, offer opt-in link; otherwise XRAI fulfills locally.
5. After 14 days user decides whether it helped; if unclear, outcome is UNCERTAIN. No claim relationships are destined or a method guarantees intimacy.

### J3 — Adult who wants to contribute to society

1. XRAI asks user's skills and voluntary time; no moral judgment for opting out.
2. Offer practical mini-course on safe mentorship/communication and creating accessible learning resource.
3. AHTOVIA teacher-created adult course or reviewed public resource may teach instructional design (teacher-student child spaces remain isolated).
4. User optionally makes a tutorial and shares wherever they choose; local evidence can be kept private.
5. No exploitation, no unverified recipient impact; separate 'I helped' from confirmed effects.

### J4 — School student in AHTOVIA; no adult XRAI profile

1. Student learns age-appropriate science/art in My School or World Campus. Parent/teacher/learner roles governed by AHTOVIA, not XRAI purpose/symbolic vault.
2. School learning evidence remains in education system's lawful, age-appropriate access controls. No automatic matching to adult spiritual profile.
3. At adulthood, a user may explicitly request portable educational credentials after independent legal/product/security assessment; do not migrate raw past school diaries or social interaction logs by default.

### J5 — Fully offline XRAI owner

1. User picks one of 7 dimension goals, gets built-in original lesson and short challenge.
2. Saves responses/evidence in encrypted local vault; no internet, no account, no AI cloud.
3. Receives local review and plan proposal from deterministic logic. AHTOVIA link is optional and later if connected.
4. Data never leaves until separate user-controlled export or permission; offline baseline path remains useful.

## §32.18 QUALITY METRICS — NOT SCREEN TIME

- First Verified Learning Experience (FVLE): percentage of people completing at least one appropriate formative task, not just tapping content.
- Meaningful Action Rate (MAR): number able to complete a user-selected realistic action, stratified by consent and available time.
- Domain learning gain: comparable baseline/post tasks with rubric, no fabricated universal progression.
- Transfer & Retention: opted-in follow-up evidence by domain with attrition reporting.
- Agency Index: opt-out ability, ability to make plan without AI (validated appropriate measurement, not arbitrary worth score).
- Fulfillment Reliability: percentage of displayed content offers actually accessible at stated price/format; unknown/unavailable counted explicitly.
- Rights Compliance: no uncategorized commercial content, expiry blocking, legal review logs.
- Privacy Leakage: zero unexpected outbound private-vault fields in instrumented tests.
- Child Safety: zero unmoderated adult-child cross-app messaging, role boundary tests.
- Cost per meaningful outcome and per active user; retain useful offline local fallback, not token-rich but ineffective chatter.
- Fairness: capability content reach across languages, proficiency, disability-related accessibility; do not use protected identity in recommendations without lawful legitimate purpose.
- Do not infer causal XRAI improvement from uncontrolled pre/post; use credible evaluation designs for causality where needed.

## §32.19 RELEASE GATES & OPEN DECISIONS

**P0 before first vertical slice:** (A) XRAI v1.4 truth/privacy/consent vault; (B) one meaningful self-discovery-to-learning path with local lesson; (C) age/role separation and no app handoff by default; (D) content rights, pricing, accessible alt and evidence schema; (E) StoreKit verified Premium from existing roadmap; (F) no screen-time or self-worth gamification.

**P1 optional AHTOVIA integration:** exact standalone AHTOVIA master spec/repo acquired and audited; API/skill mapping reviewed; eligible **adult** user consent flows; signed/validated receipts; provider rights and availability check; offline regression; separate account and entitlement enforcement; child protections; real end-to-end compatibility test.

**P2 future:** verified content marketplace, cross-app paid entitlements (not assumed), optional portable credential standards, institutional education relationships, controlled cohort learning improvements.

Open blockers: standalone AHTOVIA master document raw not available in current container; real AHTOVIA code/assets/deployed providers not reviewed; real approved licensed learning catalog missing; exact Apple subscription status and XRAI brand/IP checks missing; full child safety/legal review not done; AHTOVIA content availability untested; no human learning-outcome pilot; native code/security implementation and testing not yet performed. Keep `BLOCKED` until evidenced; do not fabricate.

## §32.22 CLAUDE DAILY EXECUTION REGIME (READ LAST)

1. `CURRENT_STATE_REPORT`: inspect actual XRAI and AHTOVIA repositories independently; enumerate build, platforms, dependencies, privacy surfaces and education content rights. If AHTOVIA unavailable, block its integration but continue local XRAI service.
2. `CANONICAL_DIFF`: compare v1.4 with this addendum, map ReqIDs `ULS-*`, screen/flow IDs, data contracts, task dependencies and testing.
3. `ADR-015`: ratify separate-app shared learning spine decision, note alternative design scoring and review triggers.
4. `SMALLEST_WORKING_SLICE`: self-discovery → selected competency → baseline → **actual original offline 5-minute lesson** → interactive practice → voluntary real-life mission → locally recorded evidence → next step. Verify device locked/privacy, offline state, cancel/opt out, source metadata.
5. `SAFE_HANDOFF_AFTER_REAL PROVIDER AUDIT`: add AHTOVIA deep link with no private payload, then adult opt-in skill handoff only with real app; signed return when supported. Do not fake completion or claim AHTOVIA content exists.
6. `TEST_AND_SOURCE_NOTES`: each completed task requires changed file refs, exact run command, pass/fail test, actual screenshot if needed, reviewed rights and residual uncertainty; human signoff for sensitive release gates.
7. `NO EXTRA ARCHITECTURE PHASES`: use existing DAG and modules, do not create new front-page tab or self-amplifying swarm; 43 existing agent role ceiling remains unless demonstrable need and approval.
8. `RELEASE`: only after privacy/leakage, age safety, pedagogy, source rights, honest evidence, local resilience, cost, Apple and independent QA gates pass.

**Final rule:** The learner must receive a real service now, not a promise to fetch some course later. The learner must retain agency and an accessible fallback. Measurable skill progress must not masquerade as a deterministic 'soul purpose.'
