# XRAI — SECURE INTELLIGENCE CORE & LOCAL-FIRST UNIVERSAL COMPUTATION CONSTITUTION v1.7
**Date:** 2026-10-16. **Status:** SPECIFIED / NOT_IMPLEMENTED / NOT_TESTED / NOT_SECURITY_AUDITED / NOT_RIGHTS_CLEARED / NOT_APP_STORE_APPROVED.
**Authority:** Additive §34, superseding contradictory implementation assumptions in XRAI v1.0–v1.6 ONLY on privacy, security, AI architecture, computation sourcing, and verified learning. Keep existing 7 dimensions, Future Self, P0–P5 proof, AHTOVIA bridge, paid $5.55 target, 148 user/ops flows, agent/DAG/test specs and prior 64 gap closure controls. All new work MUST be an implementation and audit plan, never proof it exists.

## §34.0 — EXECUTIVE / THE ONE NON-NEGOTIABLE TRUTH
XRAI is **a user-controlled, private Personal Life Intelligence Operating System**: correct deterministic math + permissioned sensitive local memory + sourced scientific/educational knowledge + OPTIONAL symbolic interpretation + consented Future Self simulations + curriculum / real-world experimentation + verifiable learning evidence. Its LLM speaks and helps plan; the LLM **does not become the source of numerical truth, identity, rights clearance, financial state or user authority.** The personal brain shall be owned by the user, not the inference provider.

**Forbidden promises:** mathematically unbreakable security; impossible to reverse engineer distributed source/weights; an objectively detected soul/purpose/intelligence/fate; astrology/Human Design objectively predicting behavior or relationships; quantum equations/frequency proving mystical claims; Apple preapproval; a model that secretly trains itself without supervision; an autonomous AI that modifies production code or policy. Strong security is risk reduction with measurement, not impossibility of compromise. Keep a deliberately simple human experience without secret data surveillance.

**Brand/UX:** XRAI X-lens, thoughtful and natural optimistic Turkish; clear positive but not forced positivity; 5 established tabs Bugün / Ben / Keşfet / Yolum / XRAI (do not add tabs by default). One next meaningful action; settings include Data Used, Why This Suggestion, How Computed, Turn Off Personalization, Offline Mode, Export and Delete. Can offer 2-screen minimal first prototype if judged feasible but cannot silently replace 5-tab approved target.

## §34.1 — DATA OWNERSHIP CLASSIFICATION AND PHYSICAL BOUNDARIES
Classify data at record/field/purpose level (not at table level only).
- `SECRET_VAULT`: birth name (including chosen/ancestral names), exact birth time/place; journals, internal conversations, sexual/relationship narratives, family narratives, medical data if voluntarily supplied, voice/face/palm image, local embeddings, personal objectives, mood reflections, personal symbolic results, exact astro maps, private model prompts, future twin memory, raw proof/video. **Device only by default**. Cloud egress denied, ad SDK events denied, crash dump denied. Encrypt at rest, minimize in RAM, protected backups.
- `PRIVATE_SHAREABLE_WITH_STEP_UP`: specific selected learning goal, separately selected skill outcome, user-selected artifact excerpt, selected optional support payload. **Device by default**, export/share only at just-in-time UI confirmation, field-level minimization, recipient/purpose display, revocable future authorization and applicable third-party retention limitation. Cannot promise guaranteed erasure from a completed external export.
- `ACCOUNT_MINIMAL`: random pseudonymous subscription entitlement reference, receipt verification fields, locale, product code, operational authentication tokens. Backend permitted as required; **never send birth chart/notes in receipt payload**. Link to person only if necessary.
- `PUBLIC_LICENSED`: public open content metadata/rights-cleared lessons/ephemeris files and independently licensed model files with provenance, version and hashes; CDN/signed bundle allowed.
- `OPTIONAL_COLLECTIVE`: strictly opt-in minimal coarse anonymized/pseudonymized outcome/correction signals, threshold privacy-risk screen, sybil defenses. No raw journals, DOB, family, biometrics, private spiritual readings. 'Differential privacy' may only be claimed if properly implemented with epsilon, delta, accounting, attacks and evaluation; never claim anonymization from deletion of a user ID alone.
- `SCHOOL_CHILD`: AHTOVIA data remains in **separate tenancy, entitlement and consent universe**. XRAI adult vault does not merge with child school identity. Guardian/teacher permissions do not grant access to intimate private XRAI journals.

**Hard outbound enforcement:** all XRAI network egress through a single `NetworkEgressGateway` with typed `OutboundDataManifest`; features cannot call arbitrary URLSession or embedded browser bridges to send local private data. Build-time static dependency scan + runtime proxy/packet review must verify no SDK bypass. Some system-provided traffic is outside the app's direct control, thus phrase proof precisely: 'No unintended app-originated private-data egress observed in tested conditions'. No blanket zero-leak guarantee.

**Backup nuance:** Device-only Keychain keys do not migrate to another device. Default iCloud OS backup may still contain app files unless correctly excluded and audited. For complete user control, encrypted recovery is opt-in with client-side key management and a separately designed recovery phrase/key; losing both device key and backup/recovery can permanently lose data. Exclude private DB and caches from standard backup when zero-cloud is promised, and test with device restore scenarios. All migration and backup policy must be explicit in onboarding.

## §34.2 — EXACT DEVICE / CLOUD SPLIT; NO FALSE FIXED PERCENTAGE
| Capability | Primary runtime | Network/default | Honest failover |
|---|---|---|---|
| Numerology, name rules, Life Path | Swift deterministic local | none | deterministic error + explanation |
| Astronomical ephemeris and timezone | local validated licensed C/Swift engine + versioned offline data | none after authorized asset installation | unavailable/approximate clearly labeled, never fake accuracy |
| Natal astrology, transits, synastry, astrocartography, relocation, Local Space | deterministic local calculation | none; optional consented coarse external place search | offline place catalogue, manual coordinates |
| Human Design gates/lines/centers/type | local math + cleared rule tables, strict uncertainty | none | blocked until license/fixture clearance |
| I Ching, numerology schools, Tarot symbolic lens | local seeded rules/controlled content | none | methodology/version disclosure |
| Journal, personal vault, Future Self, Goal DAG, Proof wallet, preferences | local encrypted storage | prohibited default | do not operate remotely silently |
| Reflection text, summaries, mentor dialogue, daily action | local Foundation Models/Core AI/approved local LLM OR non-LLM templates | prohibited default | deterministic local response, on-device model unavailable state |
| Content catalogue/source updates | device cache + signed CDN | public requests permitted | last-known-safe licensed version/offline micro lesson |
| Subscriptions, restore & fraud control | Apple StoreKit + minimum server reconciliation | minimal Apple/account data as necessary | offline cached entitlement with bounded policy and honest status |
| AHTOVIA bridge | explicit purpose-bound minimum skill records | disabled by default; opt-in | independent XRAI learning mode |
| Remote large-model reasoning | optional, separately enabled per task; if allowed sanitize locally first | NEVER silently send secret vault; raw sensitive data blocked absent exceptional explicit separate review/consent | local safe reduction, no-result, not blanket 'same quality' |
| Global product analytics | privacy-preserving aggregate counters, app opt-in depending region/policy | no DOB/chart/journal/embedding | disabled |

**No promise that 90%/99% is measured** before per-function telemetry; target is 100% of secret personal computation local by default and only nonpersonal or explicitly authorized data outbound. Network for public data/software/entitlements does not break a correctly defined local-private mode; network disclosure must be visible.

## §34.3 — XRAI BRAIN: NINE GOVERNED RESPONSIBILITIES, NOT NINE LLMS
**L0 Constitution & Permissions:** inviolable rules, consent, versioned privacy purposes, user sovereignty; can veto every task/tool. Safety policy signed in released app; server policy must not secretly loosen rights.
**L1 Evidence & Epistemic Firewall:** `DETERMINISTIC_FACT | EMPIRICAL_EVIDENCE | USER_SELF_REPORT | SYMBOLIC_TRADITION | GENERATED_HYPOTHESIS`; no promotion from symbolic narrative/LLM guess to empirical skill or sensitive fact.
**L2 Computation Kernel:** numeric dates, timezone, ephemeris, geometry, astrology, HD method registry and validity windows; typed calculators, zero LLM math.
**L3 Personal Life Graph & EncryptedVault:** user-correctable facts, provenance, contradiction, expiry and individual per-purpose consent, local search/embeddings.
**L4 Meaning & Future Self:** user-approved values, life seasons, possible purposes, optional historical mentor lenses with content provenance, not predictive fate/real person impersonation.
**L5 Education & Action:** real Learning Resource Passport, available rights-cleared XRAI lessons and AHTOVIA bridge with signed skill receipt, mission/challenge and prerequisites.
**L6 Daily Guidance & Dialogue:** one helpful next action, rest/no recommendation, natural Turkish, source/certainty and where to go; chat not endless retention trap.
**L7 Agent Orchestrator & Model Router:** permissions-first typed workflows; NO_AI > DETERMINISTIC > LOCAL_RULES > LOCAL_SMALL_MODEL > LOCAL_ADVANCED_MODEL > CLOUD_OPT_IN; manage heat/energy budget.
**L8 Evolution & Independent Verification:** personal adaptation, optional evaluated collective contribution, human-gated model updates, rollback and anti-poisoning.

Agents are **least-privilege roles** rather than independent sentient processes. All read/write via signed/validated typed commands; `AgentAccessPolicy` default deny; dynamic user consent snapshots; tool can do only predeclared actions; LLM outputs validated into typed structures; display text cannot directly mutate entitlement, profile claims, vault secrets or network egress.

**Canonical end-to-end event path:** User event → L0 purpose&consent → L1 evidence typing → L2 if deterministic truth → L3 minimal local contextual retrieval → L5 available service/skills → L7 choose cheapest eligible local model → typed structured proposal → L6 natural one-action surface → explicit user approval → L3 state transaction → L8 outcome follow-up. Absolutely no silent camera, mic, contacts, location, web browsing or hidden personality inference.

## §34.4 — MODEL STRATEGY / 'GEMMA MI LLM MI?' RESOLVED
`LLM` is a model category; **Gemma is a family of LLMs**, **Gemini** is a separate model/service family. Do not conflate them or think one provider is the XRAI core. **Our IP lies in computation correctness, permissioned memory, source/rights registries, curated learning services, personal planning and tests—not in the claim that we pre-trained a frontier model.**

**Tier 0 (no AI):** exact calculation, security policy, dates, chart geometry, HD rule graph, formula, payment/access state, consent, lesson rubric scoring when deterministic, risk constraints. Most critical.
**Tier 1 (on-device Apple first):** Swift Foundation Models `SystemLanguageModel` where available, structured outputs/tool use where verified, language generation, concise summaries, Socratic prompts. Apple model availability and model version depend on OS/device/locale; some Foundation Models APIs can also use server providers, so runtime must pin the selected **on-device** implementation explicitly. Test that selected session cannot use cloud implicitly.
**Tier 2 (on-device controlled alternative):** `Core AI` model `.aimodel` or Core ML-converted quantized model or benchmarked Gemma mobile runtime (e.g., LiteRT-LM/MediaPipe where supported/licensed). First shortlist: Gemma 3n E2B/E4B or a smaller text-only model; no hard-coded claim of memory footprint, quality, language support or compatibility. Compare actual candidate models and their licenses using a real iPhone compatibility matrix. Gemma use/distribution terms and prohibited use policies are license gates; license text/notice obligation captured.
**Tier 3 (cloud strictly optional):** server-model providers including Claude, Gemini, other enterprise APIs only for opted-in NONSENSITIVE or explicitly separately authorized, filtered payloads. Provider contract, residency, retention, subprocessor/privacy, price, rate/cost controls, security and age constraints must pass first. **Gemini API current additional terms forbid API clients directed to or likely accessed by under-18 users**; therefore do NOT select it as AHTOVIA's child-facing inference backend without a separate lawful product/contract resolving that exact restriction. Private Cloud Compute is still a server processing path; do not call it strictly 'on-device'.

**Capability router policy** (`ModelRouterPolicy`): 1) purpose/sensitivity and age gate, 2) hard accuracy boundary, 3) eligible local model capability, 4) structured schema, 5) expected latency/p95, peak RAM, storage/model download, battery/thermal, energy, 6) Turkish/multilingual evaluation score, 7) unit inference cost, 8) fallback, 9) revalidate each OS/model update. No network fallback if user selected `LOCAL_ONLY`, even if remote would produce a better answer. Use deterministic human-written templates rather than a hallucinating model for no-capability states.

**Performance budgets are launch hypotheses**, not observed measurements: app cold-start p95 <= 2.5s on target modern iPhone without warming a large model; deterministic LifePath <= 100ms p95; local short guidance p95 <= 6s on qualified devices, median <= 3s aspiration; cancellation <= 250ms user perceived; background compute constrained by iOS scheduling; benchmark start/heat/RAM/low-power/offline/OS model updates. If model fails these, fall back to deterministic/low-model mode or gate feature, not lower security.

**Local brain does not train itself in weight space by default.** Private long-term improvement uses typed memory, embeddings (also private), user preference signals, verified skills, feedback and safe ranking. Optional **local adapters** only when model/runtime supports training, consent, thermal/performance and eval constraints. Collective model training uses only separate opt-in de-identified/DP-assessed signals with retained provenance, human review, eval/poisoning barriers, signed releases and rollback. Never allow an LLM to rewrite cryptographic policy, source truth tables, evaluation suite or its own safety constitution.

## §34.5 — SECURITY DESIGN: PROTECTION, NOT 'IMPOSSIBLE TO BREAK'
**Threat model:** stolen locked/unlocked device; device passcode theft; malware/jailbreak/debug hooks; malicious app extension and deep link; SDK exfiltration; log/cache/clipboard/notification/screenshot leak; passive network adversary/MITM; malicious backend/admin; provider data retention; prompt injection via book/video/site/AHTOVIA; poisoned ephemeris/rule/model update; model inversion and personal retrieval; external recipient data misuse; backup/recovery exposure; replay subscription; malicious skill receipts; child data linkage; aggressive sharing cards. Each threat must have severity, mitigation, regression ID, owner, residual risk and abuse case.

**Cryptographic envelope, audited standard components ONLY:** app-private File Protection `NSFileProtectionComplete` (or equivalent per use case) + authenticated encryption AES-256-GCM using CryptoKit or reviewed library. Fresh unique nonces with explicit per-record format; AES-GCM nonce reuse MUST fail tests; per-collection keys derived/wrapped using reviewed KDF/key-wrapping scheme, authenticated headers AAD bind recordID/schemaVersion/purpose; key version and rotation. Store root/wrapping material in Keychain with `kSecAttrAccessibleWhenUnlockedThisDeviceOnly` / `WhenPasscodeSetThisDeviceOnly` appropriate; hardware Secure Enclave protects appropriate nonextractable private keys, not a magical generic arbitrary AES vault. FaceID/TouchID user presence for sensitive operations where useful; fallback policy explicit. Avoid claiming sensitive working-memory zeroization is guaranteed by Swift ARC/runtime.

**Vault realities:** audit SQLite encryption approach (reviewed SQLCipher licence/compliance or envelope encryption of sensitive payloads + encrypted index design), SQLite WAL/SHM, FTS token exposure, vector embedding index, Spotlight, Vision cache, thumbnails, temporary files, error logs, analytics, backup, app switcher screenshots, share previews, notification previews, crash reports and export files. Avoid storing unencrypted dates/name in metadata for indexing; private search indexes and embeddings are sensitive. Real system tests must inspect device filesystem/artifacts and network proxy traces under relevant cases. Separate operational public catalogue DB from encrypted personal vault.

**PQC readiness:** **AES-256-GCM remains strong at rest** with properly managed symmetric keys, no magical quantum algorithm needs adding to stored records. For future/hybrid transport and backups use versioned crypto suite negotiation and standardized **NIST FIPS 203 ML-KEM**, **FIPS 204 ML-DSA**, **FIPS 205 SLH-DSA** where audited platform/provider support exists, with tested protocol composition and downgrade protections. ML-KEM is key establishment, not bulk symmetric encryption. Secure Enclave support for classical operations does not imply hardware support for every PQC primitive. Avoid custom crypto and untested 'post-quantum end-to-end' label. Track long-lived confidentiality, migration, interoperability and vendor support.

**Integrity of brain:** static app signing, signed data/model/rule bundles and manifests, artifact SHA-256, schema version checks, anti-rollback appropriate to threat model, code signing/attestation if useful (attestation cannot prove an uncompromised client absolutely), locked-down tool permissions, no secrets in app bundle, server secrets backend only; rate limits. Code/weight obfuscation is not confidentiality against a determined adversary: device-distributed code and public model weights can be inspected. Protect trade secrets with server-side NONPERSONAL processes if desired, but do not move private secrets to preserve algorithm secrecy.

**Availability/recovery:** first-run empty state, corrupted vault, key loss, missing ephemeris/model download, old OS, no internet, unsupported language, 3-year absence, provider outage, app update migration, server compromise, timezone database change; fail safe, show user recoverable alternatives. Have bounded and safe reset, signed migration and rollback with no silent deletion.

**Secure SDLC:** Swift 6 strict concurrency, resource-bound actors, typed error paths, memory-conscious data handling, dependency pinning/SBOM, software supply-chain attestations, secrets scan, static and dynamic tests, OWASP MASVS + MASTG, independent penetration test, privacy red-team, disaster recovery drills; no test can certify 100% invulnerability.

## §34.6 — DETERMISTIC ASTROLOGY; ASTRO.COM RED LINE
Astrodienst astro.com Terms of Use **explicitly prohibit software/script access, systematic extraction and unauthorized commercial services based on their server resources**. **Do not scrape astro.com charts, articles, interpretations or Astro-Databank**, and do not mimic a hidden API. Use the site only for normal lawful human research/reference as permitted by terms and rights; obtain *specific written commercial licensing agreement* before any backend ingestion. Data may be compared manually under legal permission for test fixtures where suitable, with rights caveat.

**Swiss Ephemeris is a separate programmer library** from astro.com consumer content; it uses **AGPL or paid professional license**. Before shipping commercial proprietary XRAI, choose/clear a compliant commercial licence or fully compatible legal alternative. No copying of published charts, protected prose or gate wheels. Isolate ephemeris behind Swift protocol `EphemerisProvider`, independently test versions and license. Consider another authoritative/public domain numerical ephemeris with lawful source rights and separately implement astronomical conversions; do not assume all data are public-domain or same precision.

**Natal chart calculation (must be exact or uncertainty-labeled):** Gregorian/Julian calendar policy, birth local civil datetime + place IANA historical TZ/DST and ambiguities, UTC, TT/TDB/UT1 as applicable, ΔT convention/version, Julian day, ephemeris time, longitude/latitude, topocentric/geocentric convention, ecliptic/obliquity, tropical/sidereal and ayanamsa source, houses and polar fallback, aspects and orb policy, retrograde, Arabic Parts if method licensed, transits/progressions/solar return as source-defined, major time uncertainty propagation. User may not know birth time; show uncertainty rather than guessed ASC/MC/Houses or HD outputs.

**Astrocartography:** compute angularity lines for ASC/DSC/MC/IC per body from sidereal time/RA/declination; segment valid geodesic curves, wrap ±180° dateline, poles, angular/refraction conventions, numerical tolerance; include uncertainty *bands* for birth-time windows. No causal 'you will find love on this line'. `Relocation`: same UTC birth instant, new geography, new houses/angles; `Local Space`: great-circle bearing from selected anchor using topocentric altitude/azimuth (North clockwise), undefined zenith cases; `Travel Space`: **method family registry**, not an invented universal formula; `Parans`: event/crossing definition and independent fixtures. Practical place choice scores transport, language, price, legal residency, cultural preference, safety, user’s declared goals separately from astrological symbolism.

**Human Design:** historic timezone to UTC, licensed ephemeris, birth planetary positions and design event when DESIGN SUN is **88 degrees of solar ecliptic longitude earlier** (not fixed 88 days). Then licensed/verifiable mandala ordering, 64 gates/6 lines, design/personality points, channels and centers, graph connectivity, type, authority, definition, profile/cross and advanced color/tone/base/variables only after independent rules/rights research. No LLM invented positions; no definitive 'true nature'. Gate mapping/rights unclear = BLOCKED. Two independent domain checks and >=100 diverse fixtures incl time-edge cases before feature can be considered accurate.

**Numerology:** birth sum method versions/11/22/33 master distinction, compound/root, Turkish diacritics deterministic versioned normalization, given/chosen/ancestral name context explicit and optional. Mathematical consistency verified, numerological meaning always SYMBOLIC. **Name and birth numerology is not evidence of intelligence, personality or relationship prognosis**. Other symbolic schools (I Ching, Tarot, Kabala/gematria, BaZi, mudras, chakras etc) in MethodRegistry each with provenance and rights; no false combined universal 'quantum life energy' formula. Authentic Semitic script needed for precise gematria; avoid guessed mappings.

## §34.7 — CONTENT/RIGHTS & AHTOVIA BRIDGE
Human Design book photos are **restricted research inputs**, not free text to redistribute/train or display commercially. Structured nonexpressive research note + multiple independent sources + rule test + original expression + legal clearance. Copyright covers expression; facts, ideas and methods differ but jurisdiction and selection/arrangement may matter. Do not route pages to remote models without explicit permission and lawful use. OCR/manual research outputs are developer artifacts, never default shipped copyrighted corpus. No wholesale book page mirroring, imitation style or original chart graphics without rights.

XRAI lesson service must be real, rights-cleared, age appropriate and available with Resource Passport (URL/availability/licence/level/language/cost/accessibility/pre-req/update/verification). If AHTOVIA not installed/available, ship at least one original offline XRAI microcourse and practical exercise. **ULB (Universal Learning Bridge)** shares only opted-in skillID/level/objective and verifiable signed result/assessment/expiry with consent, no DOB/HD/soul/journal/family/relationship or full private prompts. Verify age and guardian rules independently; no AHTOVIA account link inferred. Gemini API age restrictions examined separately; the iOS Gemma local model's rights are independent from Gemini API terms.

## §34.8 — EVERYDAY INTELLIGENCE WITHOUT INVISIBLE EXTRACTION
Native UX: 1) clear private onboarding; 2) DOB-only free Life Path calculation as a symbolic preview, minimal questions; 3) Premium StoreKit validated if chosen; 4) one user-selected Future Self direction and optional mentor; 5) one legitimate locally available lesson/challenge; 6) proof P0-P2, eventual P3-P5 with actual evidence; 7) daily one meaningful action or rest; 8) 7/30/90/365-day reviews; 9) device-only memory and user corrections; 10) optional AHTOVIA skill-sharing and future collective learning. User need not see agents or raw numerics by default but can inspect source/method and personalization rationale. Do not pretend model outputs are measurements.

**Answer pipeline sample:** user asks “Bu hafta fizik öğrenmek istiyorum.” `IntentParser` produces typed goal (only local). `SkillGraph` checks prerequisites & user's stated level. `ResourceResolver` selects currently bundled original mini lesson + curated offline resource. `PlanEngine` offers a realistically timed short experiment. `EvidenceEngine` records performed steps, not assumed mastery. LLM converts structured state into warm Turkish text. It does not fabricate a video link, psychometric score, endorsement or any calculation. User can modify or reject.

**Self-improvement assurance:** learning loops: (1) on-device individual corrections/preferences, (2) opt-in aggregated signals with privacy-risk checks, (3) offline human-led provider evaluation and optional model updates with signed release. 'Auto-improving' means performance measured and shipping better versions, **not** unconstrained self-modifying superintelligence. Treat popularity ≠ truth, protect minority users and symbolic dissent, defend poisoning, rollback if harmful output or privacy drift, regression across languages and 7 developmental dimensions.

## §34.9 — MODEL/REFERENCE MEASUREMENT & RELEASE GATES
Test real hardware by iPhone model/OS/language/offline/thermal/memory. Model benchmark: structured schema valid, factuality with sources, abstention/certainty, non-inference of sensitive trait, Turkish style, educational validity, malicious content prompt injection, cost, peak memory, p50/p95 latency and response helpfulness. Diverse gender/ethnicity only for fairness auditing when lawful and minimized; never identity infer from appearance/name. Store anonymized synthetic golden sets for development; private personal cases only local opt-in explicit eval and deletion lifecycle.

**BLOCKER RELEASE GATES (cannot close with Markdown):**
GATE-01 no unexpected secret egress in network trace (including app extensions, analytics, search/maps, logs) across offline/online/onboarding/purchase; GATE-02 secure vault confidentiality including WAL/cache/backups; GATE-03 loss/recovery and migration; GATE-04 deterministic chart/HD reference fixtures and legal rights; GATE-05 local model genuine runtime + fallback, no implicit Private Cloud Compute or Gemini; GATE-06 prompt/tool injection denied; GATE-07 honest StoreKit verified entitlement/restore; GATE-08 AHTOVIA age/tenant boundary; GATE-09 signed data/model/version integrity; GATE-10 independent MASVS audit + no unmitigated critical risk; GATE-11 real learning offer/skills without false achievement; GATE-12 App Review truth/metadata/IP/privacy eligibility. Each needs test artifact, reviewer, timestamp, environment/build, no fabricated PASS.

Read v1.7 before older historical clauses; inspect real repository, git status, Xcode/SDK/target iOS, app entitlements, existing packages and tests; *never assume there is existing code.* Create `CURRENT_STATE_REPORT.md`, `DECISION_LOG.md`, `PRIVACY_DATA_MAP.md`, `LICENSE_MATRIX.md`, `MODEL_BENCHMARK_PLAN.md`, `SECURITY_STATUS.md`.

# XRAI — ORIGINAL INTELLIGENCE, CLEAN-ROOM COMPUTATION & PRIVACY-GOVERNED COLLECTIVE LEARNING CONSTITUTION v1.8
**Bağlayıcı yeni §35 — 16 Ekim 2026.** Önceki XRAI v1.0–v1.7 eksiksiz korunur. Bu bölüm, bağımsız hesaplama, özgün yorum/rehberlik motoru, hak yönetimi ve topluluk zekâsı bakımından yeni otoritedir. Hiçbir önceki güvenlik, rıza veya kanıt standardı gevşetilemez.

**Statü:** `SPECIFIED / REFERENCE_CONTRACTS_ONLY / NOT_PRODUCTION_CODE / NOT_SECURITY_AUDITED / RIGHTS_PENDING / NOT_APP_REVIEW_APPROVED`. Referans kodun Swift testinden geçmesi ürünün güvenli, yasal veya matematiksel olarak astronomik açıdan doğru olduğunu kanıtlamaz.

## §35.0 — Ürün gerçeği, hedef ve yasak sınırlar
XRAI **özgün bir kişisel rehberlik işletim sistemi** olacaktır. İddialı farklılaştırıcı yetenek, üçüncü tarafların metinlerini, kapalı hesap motorlarını veya müşteri verilerini kopyalamak değil, şu beş değerin birlikte çalışmasıdır: (i) doğru sürümlü matematik; (ii) kullanıcıya ait gizli yaşam hafızası; (iii) güvenilir ve fikrî hakları temiz içerik; (iv) gerçek eğitim/deney ve ölçülebilir dönüşüm; (v) mahremiyet ve kanıt korumalı sürekli iyileştirme.

**Dört sıfır tolerans:** (1) İnsanların ruhunu/geleceklerini kesin ölçtüğümüz iddiası; (2) gizli analiz/ses-kamera/konum takibi; (3) hak korumalarını aşmak, auth/captcha/paywall/rate-limit atlatmak veya uygulama binary/özel kodunu izinsiz çıkarmak; (4) özel doğum zamanı, günlük, yüz, etnik/din, çocuk kayıtları gibi verileri varsayılan model eğitim havuzuna aktarmak.

**Uygulama vaadi:** Her gün tek anlamlı ve yararlı kişisel yanıt, açıklanabilir kaynak, hata düzeltme yolu ve gerçek dünyada sınanabilir sonraki adım. Bir öneri geçerli değilse model gerektiğinde 'bilmiyorum', 'hesaplanamadı', 'kanıt yok' diyecek. Sonsuz öğrenme süreci sınırsız özerk kod değişimi değildir.

## §35.1 — Clean-room / lawful interoperability protocol
**Allowed research:** kamuya açık astronomi/algoritma bilimini incelemek; bağımsız matematiksel türetmeler; geçerli izinlere dayalı resmî API/dokümanlar; yazılı izinle erişilen program referansları; hakları temiz/açık içerik; uzman doğrulaması; içerik sınıflandırma; lisansa uygun açık kaynak; kendi ürettiğimiz test vektörleri.

**Conditioned / legal-review only:** piyasadaki rakiplerin çıktılarının manuel karşılaştırılması, çıktıların corpus'a dahil edilmesi, API yetkileri, marka ve terim kullanımı, programların işleyişine dair birlikte çalışabilirlik istisnaları; yürürlükteki hukuk ve sözleşme tarafından izin verilmeden bağımsız kopyalama veya otomatik örnekleme planlanmayacak. Farklı coğrafyalarda tersine mühendisliğin kapsamı değişebilir; hukuk uzmanı onayı gereklidir.

**Prohibited:** astro.com'u bot/script/scraper ile sistematik çekmek veya onun ticari hizmetini temel almak; gizli endpoint/API key bulmak; erişim kontrollerini atlatmak; Jovian Archive yazılımını sözleşme dışı decompile/disassemble/reverse engineer etmek; telifli kitapları veya hazır yorumları biçim değiştirilmiş türev veri tabanı/model eğitim seti yapmak; lisanssız materyali kullanıcıya ticari içerik olarak dağıtmak.

**Clean-room team split:** `Researcher`: izinli kamuya açık kaynaklardan yalnız fonksiyonel ve matematiksel gereksinim, kaynak/rights kaydı; `Implementer`: yalnız hak temiz specification'dan bağımsız Swift/C++/Rust modül kodu, dış korunan ifade/çizimler yok; `Verifier`: uygun lisanslı ephemeris/astronomi vektörleri, ortak tarihsel tarih/yer örnekleri, tolerans ve uyuşmazlık raporu. Research ve implement arasında lisanslı çıktıların sızmasını önle. Kaynak kimliği, sürüm, erişim tarihi, yasallık, lisans, kullanım amacı, güvenlik ve imza her build'de kontrol edilecek.

**Resmî kaynak kararı:** Astrodienst `astro.com` Terms of Use kullanıcı hizmeti otomasyonunu/kapturmayı sınırlar; bu, **ayrı Swiss Ephemeris** geliştirici lisansından farklıdır. Swiss Ephemeris: AGPL veya Professional; closed-source ticari dağıtım için avukatla uyumlu profesyonel hak ya da bağımsız hukukî temeli uygun alternatif seçilmeden release olamaz. NASA/JPL Horizons bilimsel **referans**, kişisel doğum verisini NASA API'ye gönderen runtime değildir; erişim kotaları/kurum kullanım şartları ayrıca kontrol edilir. Kullanım hakkı olmayan hazır Human Design corpus'u v1'e alınmaz; kendi sistemimizi özgün isim/yorumlarla kurmak gerekli marka/türev hak incelemesini kaldırmaz.

## §35.2 — Calculation Truth Kernel (`CTK`)
**Tüm hesaplar LLM dışındaki sürümlü saf fonksiyonlar ile.** `ComputationResult<T> { methodId, methodVersion, inputPrecision, value, units, astronomicalFrame, timeScale, uncertainty, referenceFixtureId, calculationTrace, provenance, rightsStatus, status }`.

Core 1 Date & Time: Gregorian/Julian seçimi, tarihsel takvim dönümleri, astronomik yıl 0 / BCE stratejisi, UTC ve tzdb sürümü, DST ambiguity/nonexistent time, dakika-saniye doğum saati belirsizliği, coğrafi koordinat doğruluğu. İki farklı uygulamada aynı UTC snapshot. Kullanıcı yanlış saati düzelttiğinde etkilenmiş grafiklerin doğrulama cache'i invalidated.

Core 2 Astronomy: zaman ölçeği (UTC, UT1, TT/TDB) için belgelenmiş dönüşümler; DeltaT model provenance; JPL DE veya profesyonel lisanslı/uygun ephemeris veri dosyası; geocentric vs topocentric; apparent vs mean; ecliptic reference epoch, nutation/precession, obliquity, sidereal ayanamsa, house systems, latitude/polar limits; unit/radian-degree normalization; sayısal doğruluk toleransları. Resmî efemeris doğruluğu yorum geçerliliği değildir.

Core 3 Astrology: tropikal/sidereal natal harita, houses, aspects/orbs, retrograde, midpoints, transits, progressions/returns; kirlenmemiş ayrı `interpretationId` ve `chartDataId`; tasarımla doğru yer/astrocartography angular lines ASC/DSC/MC/IC, relocation ve Local Space azimuth; pano farkı, antimeridian, pole, unknown time uncertainty; farklı `Travel Space` okullarını tek yöntem diye birleştirme.

Core 4 Numerology: Pythagorean / other registered systems, Unicode normalization Turkic `İ I ı i ğ ş ö ü ç` method-specific; vowels Soul, consonants Personality, Expression and aliases chosen name/family surname self-reported, master 11/22/33 variations; historical schools between methods not silently combined. Life Path only birth date needed. Result deterministic, interpretation symbolic.

Core 5 Human Design: birth instant & coordinate -> licensed/tested astronomical longitudes -> traditional Rave Mandala mapping (rights checked) -> gate/line, two epochs, Personality/Design Sun 88° longitude separation *not* arbitrary 88 calendar days; 9 centers, 36 channels, definition, type/strategy/authority/profile/cross, advanced color/tone/base only with reference rights and validators. Every rule tagged `RESEARCH_GATE | VALIDATED_MATH | RIGHTS_CLEARED | SHIP_READY`. Do NOT claim HD empirically validated personality prediction.

Core 6 cultural traditions: Kabala/gematria requires chosen original-language spelling and method; Hermetic, I Ching, Tarot, chakra/mudra etc independent school/method registry; symbol/historical provenance, no medical or physics outcomes; no invented 'universal occult formula' or inference from ethnicity, religion, biological features.

**Tests:** reproducible, cross-platform, seed-free, known fixtures with rights clear, error bounds, invalid birth dates, 29 Feb, BCE, DST overlap, timezone changed after birth, location uncertainty, HD Sun 88°, graph properties, astrologically disputed calculation variants represented as distinct methodIds. Version pinning and migration/retrocompatibility mandatory. LLM must never recompute or override CTK values.

## §35.3 — Original Interpretation Engine (`OIE`), not an astrology-content clone
`CalculationFacts` (verified math) + `SymbolicTraditionRecord` (explicitly interpretive) + `UserValues` (local opt-in) + `LifeEvidence` (assessed) + `UserIntent` + `LearningOffers` -> **typed `GuidanceCandidate[]`**.

**Rules Engine:** Independently authored, legally cleared condition rules tied to `methodId` and symbolism version, deterministic confidence for rule execution only. *A rule firing has no psychological truth probability.* Never silently change or average incompatible traditions.

**Knowledge Retrieval:** rights-managed XRAI original corpus (fact-checked learning cards, scientific sources, original lesson, author-approved short public quotes only as allowed, official/permissioned sources), indexed with source IDs. No downstream ingestion if license forbids ML embedding, commercial use or derivatives. Citation provenance and freshness.

**Epistemic Conflict Firewall:** each candidate tagged `DETERMINISTIC | EMPIRICAL | SELF_REPORT | SYMBOLIC | HYPOTHESIS`. A sentence may combine classes only with explicit transitions. 'You are a genius because of birth number' rejected. 'This tradition associates X with exploration; you can try this' permitted.

**Meaning & Future Self:** no objectively discovered soul; user's proposed narratives ('maybe I enjoy scientific curiosity'), multiple hypotheses and reversible plans. Historical Einstein-like mentor labelled original simulation inspired by sourced scientific practice, not real persona or false quotes. XRAI asks permission before converting symbol idea into actual educational plan.

**Learning Offer Compiler:** a guidance candidate must attach AVAILABLE `LearningOffer`: rights-cleared original XRAI microcourse, AHTOVIA permissioned bridge, verified external resource or safe real-world task, with `availableAt`, level, cost, locale, age suitability, time, prerequisites, safety, assessment rubric and fallback. If unavailable, do not fake it.

**Natural Language Presenter:** concise positive but not forced; default one recommendation, optional why/evidence, all technical formula behind user-requested disclosure; user can skip/reject; no hidden manipulation. LLM's only authority: draft language and optional low-risk plan candidate; schema validator/claim verifier decides final display. Provide sentence-level `claims[]` for traceability while private source stays on device.

## §35.4 — Privacy-preserving local Personal Brain (`PB`)
Local `PersonalLifeGraph` source of truth, encrypted file/database + versioned key envelopes; semantic index/embeddings local; family/child records distinct namespaces; deletion propagation to local cached summaries/embeddings; model responses restricted to **retrieval by purpose**. Personal memory is not a model provider's permanent training database.

Allowed device learning: user correction, preference weights, user-confirmed goal updates, eligibility constraints, retrieval ranking, local adapters where library/device actually supports with explicit permission, sandboxed eval; **no** unsupervised modification to security rules, executable code, deterministic algorithm or weights.

`MemoryFact` fields: `id, ownerDeviceScope, class, epistemicType, valueRef, sourceId, timeSpan, userConfirmed, consentPurpose, retrievalScope, expiresAt, supersedesId, correctionHistory[]`. Consent is revocable; old interpretations tied to invalidated birth data must not persist as facts.

Runtime privacy: Keychain ThisDeviceOnly for encryption KEKs where appropriate, Secure Enclave EC key/wrap protocol when supported (not claim AES-256 key itself resident as generic symmetric Secure Enclave key); audited AEAD encrypt, DB WAL/FTS/temp/index, thumbnails/attachments, app protection classes, disable default iCloud backup on sensitive files when promising strict local-only, test export/import/rekey/loss. Verified ownership and restore UX. All outbound requests through gate; deny arbitrary dynamic URL upload. Network gateway cannot control OS/other apps; scope claims to tested app-originated traffic.

## §35.5 — Collective Brain: `PUBLIC KNOWLEDGE + GUARDED QUALITY SIGNALS`, NEVER ALL PERSONAL DATA
**Brain A** (per person): raw DOB, life narrative, journals, relationship context, AI chat history, photos, biometrics, goals and proof private local. **Brain B**: shared public/licensed learning sources, non-personal algorithm fixes, test fixtures, rights-cleared content, optional coarse privacy-screened effectiveness feedback. **Brain C** (review-controlled): shared model/rule release candidates evaluated on licensed or purpose-consented datasets. Distinct retention/rights from A and B.

Participation `OFF` by default. Separate opt-ins: `SHARE_ANONYMOUS_CONTENT_QUALITY`, `SHARE_COARSE_LEARNING_FEEDBACK`, `PARTICIPATE_RESEARCH`, `MODEL_TRAINING_CONSENT`. Avoid misleading 'anonymous': if reidentification risk remains, label pseudonymous/personal and obey privacy law. Each consent states purpose, categories, time retention, recipient, data examples, region; deny child personal spiritual records/training by default. No third-party private text or biometric raw by default.

**Proposed contribution pipeline:** device consent snapshot -> local minimization -> sensitivity scanner (cannot ensure perfect detection) -> cohort-size & low-frequency uniqueness tests -> clipped contributions -> optional DP mechanism with epsilon/delta accountant *only if implemented and benchmarked* -> secure/authenticated upload -> poison/sybil filtering -> segmented evaluator -> fairness/bias review -> human-gated signed model/content release -> device roll-forward & rollback. FL is **optional research**: gradients can leak details, secure aggregation not magic, poisoning & privacy budgets apply. Start with NO federated training; coarse educational-resource ratings + explicit QA corrections. Purpose-bound withdrawal stops future collection and deletes held raw contributions where applicable; distributed trained model unlearning cannot be promised unless verified.

**Never optimize for:** max interaction time, manipulative streaks, addictive intimacy with historic mentor, inferred religion/ethnicity, sensitive matchmaking or ranking people by spiritual enlightenment. Group fairness/cultural multilingual tests needed, no hidden social categorization. Global impact report aggregate with denominator and bias caveats; experimental causality != measured improvement.

## §35.6 — Octopus Cognitive Orchestrator (`OCO`)
One orchestration graph rather than 35 simultaneous heavy LLMs; 10 scopes: `PolicyGuardian`, `ExactMath`, `RightsSource`, `KnowledgeGraph`, `SymbolicInterpreter`, `UserMeaning`, `CurriculumPlanner`, `EvidenceAssessor`, `DialogueCraft`, `EvolutionGovernor`. Source- and policy-level domains are isolated; least privilege, typed calls, circuit breaker, deterministic decisions always out of reach of generative model.

**Router precedence:** NO_AI -> deterministic local rules -> local lightweight retrieval/templates -> Apple on-device Foundation Models if available -> licensed on-device Core ML/MLX/Gemma adapter if benchmarked -> explicit opt-in external model for sanitized non-sensitive task. Do not infer all LLMs run locally because a common Foundation Models API also supports remote profiles. Runtime `computeLocation=DEVICE` must be pinned and tested.

**Agent card:** `agentId, allowedCommands, allowedDataClasses, toolsAllowlist, maximumTokens, maxLatencyMs, maxBatteryCost, failClosed, forbiddenActions, expectedSchema, evaluatorFixtureSet, shadowMode, humanApprovalNeeded`. Tool-to-tool message provenance preserved. Third-party web/text can inject instructions; treat external content as data, NEVER source of app permissions or tool instructions.

**Five anti-hallucination gates:** Math must originate CTK; quoted sources need provenance and correct rights; suggestions need actual offered service; skill claim needs rubric/corroboration; sensitive inference prohibited. Always support 'answer unknown/unavailable' state. A model agent may draft an interpretation but cannot upgrade itself to verifier.

**Model quality evaluation** on real devices: Turkish/English/multilingual fidelity, reasoning, schema adherence, disclosure accuracy, safety, reproducibility, response latency p50/p95, memory peak, device RAM, offline failure, background energy, thermal; compare models under consistent dataset and user consent; costs/cloud fallback. No universal 'superintelligent' certification. Dynamic model inventory and signed rollbacks. One model can express multiple skills via typed policy; no fabricated model training or large fleet.

## §35.7 — XRAI × AHTOVIA learning isolation and minors
AHTOVIA receives only user-authorized `skillId, trainingGoal, locale, selected availability/accessibility, proof receipt` fields, not birth/HD/spiritual/psychometric/private life information. Children use independent, age-appropriate interest-and-skill discovery; no fixed 'soul purpose' score, esoteric life destiny, hidden identity profiling, sensitive tracking, manipulative historical character attachments. Separate parent/teacher role access (educational progress only). Separate commercial identity and COPPA/GDPR-KVKK counsel/consent checks. When counterpart offline/unreleased, XRAI original local microcourse fallback.

## §35.8 — Rights/API/provider engineering
`ProviderRegistry {providerId, classification, tosURL, licenseContractHash, permittedMethods, authentication, requestLimits, cachePolicy, loggingPolicy, redistributable, commercialRights, modelTrainingAllowed, revocationPolicy, failureMode, verifiedAt, reviewer}`.

No arbitrary 'find any API and go around the obstacle'. Fallback hierarchy: licensed first-party dataset -> appropriately licensed independent method -> legally usable local content -> user manual entry -> unavailable with explanation. Every provider integration needs contract tests, expiry kill switch, no content leakage, business continuity and cost budgets. `Website terms differ from algorithm and ephemeris licensing`; avoid conflation.

Human Design protected material: permissions sought for term/graphics/text/software rights. If not cleared, keep in independent `RESEARCH_ONLY`, release general-purpose `Self Discovery Atlas` with original concepts and lawful astro math but not copied HD chart/derivative teaching. Book images are individual developer research materials, not implicitly reusable model corpus.

## §35.9 — Runtime event contract / concrete worked example
1. User provides DOB locally. `LocalVault` encrypts field and records consent purpose.
2. `ExactMath` calculates LifePath by rule; `ComputationResult` contains correct input, method, root/compound and nonfatal warning.
3. `SymbolicInterpreter` obtains own rights-cleared summary, labels SYMBOLIC and does not assert trait as fact.
4. `UserMeaning` checks optional user-selected interests, privacy grant. If not present, question asks rather than infers.
5. `CurriculumPlanner` requests one original/verified learning offer from catalogue. For curious Einstein mentor, choose appropriate **science microcourse**, not a fake 'Einstein soul match'.
6. `DialogueCraft` suggests concise natural-language action and displays 'symbolic inspiration' label with 'Why'.
7. User may refuse, correct info, or accept. No persistent claim updated without approval.
8. Lesson opens offline, assessment + project are recorded with `EvidenceTier` only when rubric passes; no false competence upgrade.
9. Personal adaptation next day uses observed user actions + user reflection, not predictions from planets.
10. Optional separate contribution: user approves sharing a coarse lesson helpfulness rating without dates/birth data; server rejects unusual sparse cells, no secret journal transmission. Content update released after review and rollback test.

## §35.10 — Reliability, governance, attack stories
Threats: stolen/unlocked phone, key loss, malicious model output, prompt injection through books or source pages, silent SDK egress, IAP spoofing, poisoned crowd votes, gradient inversion, sybil and brigading, GPS/birth timezone poisoning, copyrighted imitation, 'HD formula' error, malicious rule update, popular bias, hidden paywall, PII in push notifications/screenshots/analytics, ad retargeting leakage, child data merges, deleted-but-embedded vectors, rollback preventing bad update, Apple App Review false claim.

Each gets a `RiskClosureRecord {riskId, priority, owner, codePath, abuseFixture, requiredTest, independentReview, releaseGate, status, evidenceRef, residualRisk}`. iOS runtime and network egress verified separately. Security must use recognized standards and independent review, not 'we invented unbreakable crypto'. Post-quantum readiness via crypto agility and standards/e2e capabilities, not blanket quantum-proof marketing. All platform/cloud dependencies versioned and license screened.

## §35.11 — Success criteria and metrics
North star: **meaningful user-selected life improvement supported by appropriately classified evidence**. Measure task and skill actual outcomes separately from entertainment engagement, daily returning user, retention, mentor persona appeal. Compare 30/90/365 days against baseline where appropriate; controls for selection bias and attribution, not all success XRAI-caused. Equality tests across language, region, lower-powered phone, disability/accessibility, minor boundaries. Privacy metrics: unexpected sensitive app-originated transfer = 0 in test capture; purpose denial leads no data access; consent change invalidates caches. Performance, quality, unit economics and QA gate per release.

## §35.12 — Engineering rollout / freeze
`MVP`: privacy gate, local vault, LifePath, original interpretive rule and disclosure, editable goal, 1 licensed mini lesson, 1 real assessment, StoreKit premium. `Next`: initial historical mentor (Einstein *inspired*), user-specific learning plans, AHTOVIA consent bridge. `Advanced gated`: independently rights-cleared chart, Human Design, astrocartography, optional privacy-preserving collective AI, supervised model adaptation. ## §36.4 — Epistemic firewall and counterexamples
Each claim must be assigned exactly one primary class plus optional connections: `MATH_VERIFIABLE`, `HISTORY_DOCUMENTED`, `TRADITION_INTERPRETIVE`, `EMPIRICAL_SUPPORTED`, `HYPOTHESIS_UNVERIFIED`, `MARKETING_UNVERIFIED`. Do not transfer certainty from math (e.g., correct 5-point star) to metaphysics (a star proves five universal hidden forces). Correlation, similarity, chronology, and causation remain separate. A concept may be mathematically certain and physically unjustified as applied to a person.

**Mandatory rebuttal/qualification examples:**
- 'Every symbol encodes one unified universal law' -> interesting syncretic philosophy, not established physical proof.
- 'The torus shape is the energy field of every human' -> toroidal fields exist in physics; screenshot supplies no direct measurement of personal mystical field.
- 'E=mc² confirms consciousness manifests external reality' -> category error: mass–energy equivalence does not entail wish-based causation.
- 'The quantum double-slit experiment proves observers create reality with thoughts' -> incorrect inference; measurement interactions must not be equated with human belief.
- 'Left hemisphere logical / right hemisphere spiritual implies fixed person type' -> oversimplified neuromyth; no personal classification.
- 'A chakra is blocked based on body photo' -> no medically validated sensor or diagnosis; no inference.
- 'A1–Z26 numbers show the perfect human' -> method-defined linguistic symbolism, not objective moral, ability, intelligence or biological status.
- 'A cultural tradition is secretly the same as another because symbols match' -> require independent history, transmission evidence and compare differences.
- 'The author proved the universal source code' -> source's belief/marketing claim, not accepted evidence.

`RAG` means retrieval of **approved original or licensed chunks only**. Do NOT embed complete unauthorized copies of this author's books in retrieval vectors; embeddings do not make the source redistribution rights-free. The research repository is separate from distributed app package, outputs and training corpora. Rights gate may block any 'Book of Wisdom' branded book guide or page-specific paraphrase that acts as a market substitute. End user may optionally analyze **a copy they lawfully possess** locally for private personal use subject to local legal terms; user content is not globally ingested/trained/synced without distinct rights and lawful basis. A user upload is NOT proof of permission to reproduce its contents commercially.

**Anti-copyright-laundering controls:** `researchSourceFingerprint`, `originalExpressionSimilarityReview`, `figureRedrawProvenance`, `licenseGrantId`, `redistributionAllowed`, `modelTrainingAllowed`, `quoteLimit`, `expiryAndKillSwitch`. Do not imitate layout/text diagrams or lightly rephrase original passages. ## §37.0 — User intent, hard boundary and output promise

Nothing silently disappears because it is controversial; it is classified as `SCIENTIFIC_SUPPORTED`, `CONTESTED`, `SPECULATIVE`, `RELIGIOUS_CULTURAL`, `SYMBOLIC`, `MISLEADING_OR_UNSUPPORTED`, or `NOT_YET_ASSESSED` with visible sources. **Inclusion in research does not imply inclusion as app truth, recommendation, protected diagram or copyrighted full text.**

A complete book transcription, translation reproducing the book, page-faithful competing summary/substitute, copied images, derivative re-creation or training the commercial XRAI model directly on the protected full work is not authorized merely by upload or online access. **Actually visible:** 10 cropped screenshots submitted by the user (one product listing plus 9 video stills); publisher's current product descriptions; limited bibliographic public metadata; two Instagram URLs whose streams could not be fully audited. v1.9 already recorded 32 thematic lenses, but those 32 are **not an official TOC**. Publicly posted unauthorized scans are not an alternative commercial permissions path.

## §37.2 — Complete coverage ledger: no dropped page, no fabricated certainty

There shall be a `Work → Volume → Edition → Chapter → PhysicalPage → Media → Claim/Diagram/Equation → Verification → OriginalLearningArtifact` graph. Unnumbered front matter, foldouts, illustrations, appendices, bibliography, errata and back matter all get page IDs. Use original physical sequence plus printed numbering to catch discrepancies. Treat edition as stable source identity. Model status states: `NOT_RECEIVED`, `RECEIVED_BLURRY`, `RECEIVED_LEGIBLE`, `REVIEWED`, `NEEDS_RETAKE`; `RESEARCH_COMPLETE` only when actual page counts are established and all actual pages are legibly processed and cross-reviewed, and unresolved ambiguous materials are clearly marked. Publisher text summaries must never set research-complete.

Maintain counters (unknown until actual books supplied): `expectedPages`, `receivedPages`, `legiblePages`, `reviewedPages`, `conceptsReviewed`, `claimsAssessed`, `diagramsMapped`, `calculationsIndependentlyVerified`, `rightsReleased`, `assetsPublished`. No success percentages while denominators are unknown. A source may be fully *analyzed privately* while zero of its protected assets are licensed for the app.

Attach private evidence page: image SHA-256, page index, clear/blurred flags, exact edition, no public screenshot transmission, claim IDs, disagreement notes, rights status, independent reviewer. Do not use mass OCR on low-resolution reels as evidence; user should supply original readable page photos/PDF for detailed reading. Keep small batches (10–15 pages), retain continuity, avoid full book text in code comments, model prompts persisted to cloud, logs or public documents.

## §37.3 — Scholarly claim ledger: each statement gets a provenance and a countercheck

Every assertion requires classification:

| Record type | Examples | Gate |
|---|---|---|
| `MATHEMATICAL_IDENTITY` | Torus equations, polygon angles, true wavelength-frequency relations | Explicit coordinate/convention, unit tests, independently verified goldens |
| `HISTORICAL_FACT` | Provenance of Hermetic texts, Egyptian symbols, name-number systems | Primary texts where lawful, credible independent scholarship, dates/translation nuance |
| `CULTURAL_INTERPRETATION` | Planet-metal/plant analogies, chakras, microcosm, sigils | State tradition, school, era, alternative schools; no universal causal claim |
| `RELIGIOUS_ASSERTION` | Spiritual cosmology, divine unity, rebirth descriptions | Faith/philosophical interpretation, not science |
| `EMPIRICAL_CLAIM` | Pineal healing, aura measurement, quantum consciousness, torus in body | Domain-specific strong evidence, corrections/contradictions, never convert unsupported into established fact |
| `PERSONAL_REFLECTION` | User's felt meaning, meditation narrative, symbols that resonate | User-owned local choice; no diagnosis, destiny, innate-worth ranking |
| `PUBLISHER_MARKETING` | Guaranteed awakening, hidden power, transformation | Attribute as promotion; never copy into product fact claims |

Multi-tradition comparisons must use typed edges `HISTORICALLY_CONNECTED`, `SHARED_TERMINOLOGY`, `SIMILAR_VISUAL`, `DIFFERENT_MEANING`, `CLAIMED_RELATION_UNVERIFIED`. Similar drawing ≠ same source, clinical efficacy, or physics law. Track original versus secondary sources, alternative hypotheses, disagreement and correction. Store mathematical outputs separately from symbolic explanation outputs.

### Physical science and mathematical literacy
- Light and electromagnetic spectrum
- Wave frequency wavelength and energy relations
- Visible color vs metaphoric aura color
- Torus topology and field visualization
- Geometry of pentagrams and polygons
- Physics vs spiritual resonance analogies
- Double slit experiment as actual experiment
- E=mc^2 and limits of physical analogies
- Neuroscience hemispheric specialization and myths
- Pineal gland physiology and unsupported awakening claims

### Numbers and script correspondences
- Pythagorean numerological mapping
- Alphabet ordinal A1-Z26
- Historical gematria and language-specific transliteration
- Chaldean numerology as separate school
- Name compounds and vowel/consonant rules
- Masculine/feminine number correspondences as historical claims
- Biblical/personal name examples (Adam, Eve, Man)
- Source-specific esoteric equation verification

### Astrology and planetary correspondences
- Seven classical planets and weekday conventions
- Planet-metal correspondences
- Planet-gemstone/plant/animal associations
- Western occult and alchemical historical chart variants
- Zodiac iconography
- Planetary astronomy vs planetary symbolic causation

### Cultural symbols and comparative iconography
- Eye of Horus historical iconography
- Ankh and life-symbol traditions
- Sigils including Lucifer/symbol history
- Pentagram four/five element interpretations
- Elemental diagrams and cross-cultural variation
- Hand and five senses analogies
- Finger and planet symbolism variants
- Sacred geometry historical claims
- Egyptian relief and artifact provenance
- Uterus/torus/heart resemblances, not anatomical evidence

### Religion, mysticism and traditional practice
- Chakra and kundalini traditions
- Third-eye narratives
- Christ oil/chrism bodily claims and scientific status
- Sacred texts as metaphor vs historical exegesis
- Grounding/meditation/reflective practices
- Vital/sexual energy conservation claims
- Food, nature and wellness claims
- Cultural provenance and appropriation protections

### Human flourishing and educational applications
- Meaning and life-purpose reflection
- Critical thinking about impressive-looking correlations
- Careful falsification of extraordinary claims
- Creative expression as optional experience
- Awe, contemplation and personal perspective
- Safe daily practices and bounded experiments
- XRAI original learning and AHTOVIA educational bridge
- Privacy, spiritual autonomy and preventing coercion

## §37.5 — No copyright laundering or hidden model training

Store in THREE physically/logically separated domains:

A. `RESTRICTED_SOURCE_RESEARCH_VAULT` (developer-controlled, privately uploaded lawful copies, page evidence, no app distribution, no model training by default). App users' local book research remains on their own devices if product option exists, separate from team corpus.

B. `INDEPENDENT_METHOD_AND_CLAIM_REGISTRY` (method, logic, historical provenance, mathematical golden examples, editorial classification; no complete protected prose, substantial recreated sequence or images).

C. `SIGNED_XRAI_ORIGINAL_KNOWLEDGE_PACKS` (new original text, independently designed graphics, original educational examples and licensed assets only; can be on-device and cached; permissioned for intended market and age group).

The rights gate separately evaluates reading, reproduction, translation, adaptation, user display, redistribution, text-and-data mining, embeddings, fine-tuning, quoted material, voice/likeness and book title/brand. A right in one category does not confer all. A fair-use/fair-dealing theory is not a guaranteed release authorization; qualified counsel reviews relevant jurisdiction and licensing. Generated images that trace source figures too closely are BLOCKED. Do not copy page sequence into a substitute curriculum. Don't design around access controls or publisher restrictions.

## §37.6 — XRAI brain: knowledge is not equal to personal profiling

`SOURCE_RESEARCH → EDITORIAL_VERIFICATION → ORIGINALLY_AUTHORED_KNOWLEDGE → SIGNED_KNOWLEDGE_PACK → ON_DEVICE_RAG (approved packs only) → USER_SELECTED_WISDOM_EXPERIENCE → OPTIONAL_PRACTICE → PERSONAL_REFLECTION LOCAL-ONLY → OPTIONAL ANONYMOUS/CONSENTED QUALITY SIGNAL → GOVERNED MODEL/CONTENT EVAL`.

No symbolic belief from the book can become a user's verified skill, spiritual rank, IQ, psychological diagnosis, medical claim or fixed life purpose. User may decline esoteric content altogether. XRAI's 9-layer constitution and 3 learning loops remain unchanged. No learning from raw journal, religious identity, birth chart or private messages by default. The ahtapot/agent planner has no ability to modify source/rights policy, take autonomous action outside typed commands or promote a controversial claim by voting. Model self-improvement is evaluated, versioned and rollbackable, not live unsupervised self-training.

## §37.7 — Original user experiences: what actually ships if rights and accuracy permit

- **Cultural Connections Atlas:** Explore a historical symbol with documented origins, where traditions diverge and what XRAI knows/does not know; visualized from ORIGINAL artwork, with alternative accounts.
- **Astronomy and historical astrology:** Precise location/time maths in a licensed on-device calculation engine, traditional meanings separate; no exact personal birth info shared with AHTOVIA.
- **Geometric Laboratory:** Torus, polygons, symmetry, and field visualizations accurately explainable, plus historic symbolic interpretations on a separate tab.
- **Numbers and Scripts:** User-selected school mapping with versioned normalization, custom name-alphabet examples; no universal perfection score.
- **Light and Color:** Real EM spectrum simulation, color perception/optics, traditional color symbolism in separate lesson.
- **Critical Thinking Studio:** Confront 'visual similarity means physical law' mistakes without mocking spiritual beliefs; source-check challenges.
- **Reflection and Future Self:** Optional prompt that lets user decide meanings; no false soul scanning.
- **AHTOVIA Universal Learning Bridge:** Send generic learning topic (geometry, history, physics, art, comparative religion) and chosen level only after affirmative consent; separate age/guardian checks; return verifiable skill result, not personal spiritual profile.

For every offer, resolve `lessonExists`, `canOpenOffline`, `sourceRights`, `correctLevel`, `language`, `timeBudget`, `ageGate`, `userConsent`, `assessmentRubric`, `fallback`. If inaccessible, label unavailable; do not fabricate link/curriculum. Physical/spiritual practices include age, medical risk and noncoercion guards, and no guaranteed cure or exceptional consciousness claims.

## §37.8 — Exact engineering contracts and source cover completeness

Companion files:

- `SOURCE_EVIDENCE_MANIFEST_v2.0.json`: public/current sources and hashes for 10 user stills; none is entire book.
- `BOOK_TOPIC_COVERAGE_REGISTER_v2.0.json`: thematic backlog with provenance and uncertainty markers, NOT the TOC.
- `PAGE_EVIDENCE_SCHEMA_v2.0.json`: input page record for exact edition/page/evidence/rights.
- `CLAIM_PROVENANCE_SCHEMA_v2.0.json`: claim type, provenance, empirical status, rights, output status.
- `BOOK_PAGE_COVERAGE_TEMPLATE_v2.0.csv`: deliberately unfilled page inventory; counts unknown.
- `CLAUDE_BOOK_RESEARCH_DAG_v2.0.json`: sequential 20 research and implementation tasks.
- `BOOK_ACCEPTANCE_TESTS_v2.0.json`: 42 planned adversarial/test scenarios, all NOT_RUN.

`PageEvidence` must be owned by intake workflow, not public application database. `ClaimRecord` correction events invalidate derived outputs; no generated claim can recursively 'prove' itself. `CalculationMethod` is published only with explicit rule set, test fixtures and correct license. `KnowledgePackRelease` requires signed version, rights review, source/provenance, user-safe content preview, no-PII network egress test, accessibility and rollback. Every content update is auditable.

## §37.9 — Explicit Claude acceptance barriers and evidence

- `PRIVATE_BOOK_REVIEW_COMPLETE` only when the exact two editions have every actual physical page legible and reviewed, including inserts and back matter; two editorial reviewers validate completeness and contradictions. Partial reels cannot satisfy.
- `TOPIC_EXTRACTED` does not imply `RIGHTS_CLEARED`, `SCIENTIFIC_SUPPORTED` or `PUBLISHED`.
- `PUBLISHABLE_ORIGINAL_MODULE` requires independent sources, editorial provenance, original expression/illustration, commercial/translation/AI rights review, age-safe truth label, test/rubric and approved build artifact.
- `XRAI_IOS_FEATURE_VERIFIED` needs actual iPhone/simulator run and observed test logs; planning only is NOT_IMPLEMENTED.
- `WHOLE_BOOK_SHIPPED_IN_APP` is not a permitted engineering target without necessary express licenses and qualified IP review.
- `SOURCE_URL_AVAILABLE` does not imply lawful right to systematically copy/download or package content, even if a scan is posted on a third-party site.

Deliver each session: `SOURCE_AUDIT_DATE`, edition known/unknown, page coverage by volume, claims audited, math methods with independent tests, copyright status, original assets/lessons produced, tests actually run, unresolved blockers, changed file paths, and exact next missing page batch. Do not invent success metrics or claim the user now knows absolute secrets of the universe.

## §37.10 — Start instruction for next user-supplied batch

Ask user to upload **cover + copyright/ISBN + table of contents** of BOTH volumes, followed by readable sequential groups of 10–15 pages, or full lawfully acquired ebook PDFs. Compare edition against official public bibliographic data. Pages owned by user may be summarized/annotated privately for their own research, but commercial product requires separate original-content and rights gate. Without those pages retain `FULL_BOOK_NOT_READ`. Offer upload instructions, do not treat marketed contents as an exhaustive TOC.

**Priority:** Build the page coverage ledger FIRST; do not inflate next master version with invented lore. Preserve XRAI v1.9 and its 32 candidate lenses; v2.0 extends to an initial 68 research topic register with explicit uncertainty, without replacing original 32 or declaring official completeness.
